articleTitle: Research on the Construction Method of Landscape Information Model Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the development of information technology, computer digital technology is widely used in the process of landscape design. GIS technology provides powerful help in landscape planning and design, and expands the creative generation way through qualitative and quantitative integrated environment. In this paper, the construction method of landscape information model is studied from the perspective of landscape design, and the process and functional characteristics of landscape information model construction are proposed. The basic framework of landscape information model is constructed through sustainable theory, graphic theory and decision theory, GIS technology is adopted, and visual interaction platform is used to improve the landscape information model, and multiple sensory elements are combined to carry out landscape experience. Finally, the landscape information model can reproduce the environment, simulate and predict the process, and provide more scientific and reliable guidance for landscape design.

articleTitle: An Analytical Study of Hyperparameters and Architectural Impacts for Image Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Super-resolution is particularly helpful for applications like larger computer screens, portable electronics like cellphones and cameras, and high-definition television sets. It plays a crucial role in improving visual perception by transforming low-resolution images into clearer, high-resolution ones. The integration of deep learning methodologies has demonstrated significant promise in mitigating the constraints of conventional approaches. Three traditional deep learning networks are used in this experiment to perform picture super-resolution tasks. This experiment uses the well-known Very Deep Super-Resolution (VDSR) network as a reference and evaluates the effects of different hyperparameters on the results. The experiment then presents the Convolutional Neural Network with Recurrent Neural Network (CNN+RNN) and Generative Adversarial Network (GAN). The benefits of these various network topologies are contrasted, and the differences and enhancements provided by each configuration are examined. Lastly, subjective comparison graphs are provided and objective measurements are used to assess the outcomes. The quality of the experimental results is directly impacted by the network structure's complexity.

articleTitle: Design of BOM and Data Detection Algorithm for Railway Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The BOM architecture is proposed in this paper from the production process of railroad vehicles, combined with the current situation of BOM in a company. The construction methods of MBOM and SBOM are elaborated in this paper. In order to quickly and accurately detect outliers in BOM part number data, an unsupervised learning algorithm based on isolated forest is proposed and compared with the box plot. The results show that the unsupervised learning algorithm based on isolated forests performs better for outlier detection. This study meets the rapid development needs of railway vehicles and provides a reference for other companies to solve BOM management problems.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Access Control Recognition Framework Based on Asian Face Data Augmentation and Edge Computing Optimization in Private University Campuses
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: To address the practical needs of campus security management in private universities, this paper proposes an intelligent access control system based on facial recognition. To enhance the accuracy of the model in Asian facial recognition tasks, we designed a data augmentation strategy tailored to Asian facial features, thereby increasing the diversity and richness of the training data. By integrating edge computing technology, we optimized the facial recognition model through methods including model pruning, quantization, and knowledge distillation, achieving efficient deployment on edge devices. Experiments conducted on a subset of Asian faces from the VGGFace2 dataset demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms traditional approaches such as LSTM and CNN in terms of accuracy, inference time, model size, and energy consumption. This success enables real-time and efficient facial recognition on edge devices. The research findings provide effective technical support for smart campus security management in private universities.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Innovation Interaction Model Based on Complex Network and Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes an enterprise innovation interaction model based on complex network and big data analysis. The model uses PageRank algorithm to analyze the importance of each node in the enterprise innovation network, identify the core enterprises in the innovation activities and their key roles in the cooperation network. By constructing a complex network, the cooperation relationship in the enterprise innovation system is visualized, and valuable interaction patterns are extracted by combining big data analysis. The system design includes modules such as data preprocessing, complex network construction and PageRank algorithm implementation, which can effectively improve the accuracy of enterprise innovation interaction. During the simulation process, the paper used a real data set containing 500 enterprises and 2000 cooperation projects. The results show that the system can significantly improve the efficiency of identifying key nodes in the cooperation network between enterprises. The node importance identification accuracy of the PageRank algorithm reaches 93.2%, which is about 10% higher than the traditional method. In addition, the simulation results show that the prediction accuracy of core node identification and innovation interaction patterns in complex networks has also been significantly improved.

articleTitle: Face Makeup Transfer Algorithm Based on CycleGAN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Face makeup transfer is a popular research direction in the domain of computer vision, where makeup style is considered a special style of facial images, and makeup transfer is a part of style transfer. The process of human face makeup transfer is to transfer the makeup of the reference makeup image to the original makeup image while keeping the facial characteristics of the original makeup image. Currently, Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have become the mainstream technology for solving the problem of face makeup transfer. Face makeup transfer will be widely used in the future, such as in beauty cameras, makeup software for one-click makeup, virtual makeup trials for cosmetics, and video makeup transfer (such as live streaming software makeup and TV drama character makeup), and has received widespread attention in recent years. It has significant research value both in academia and industry. In this study, the paper adopted a series of innovative strategies to optimize model performance, including the introduction of non-local attention mechanisms to enhance feature extraction capabilities, improved residual blocks to increase network depth and efficiency, and attention modules in discriminators to improve focus on key features. Additionally, the paper used multi-scale discriminators to capture feature information at different levels and added skip connections to promote gradient flow and information integration, thereby achieving more efficient network training and better performance.

articleTitle: Research on algorithms for multimodal knowledge fusion in intelligent knowledge graph construction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of digital technology and intelligent information systems, the application of multimodal knowledge fusion in the construction of intelligent knowledge graphs has attracted more and more attention. However, the research on the construction of intelligent knowledge graphs is still relatively limited and needs to be further explored. As an important part of the field of artificial intelligence, the complex internal relationships and multi-source heterogeneous data environment of intelligent knowledge graphs pose new challenges to researchers and developers. Therefore, this paper proposes to build a more intelligent and efficient knowledge graph based on the wavelet-fractional multivariate grey prediction model and combines digital technology and intelligent information systems. Wavelet analysis enables us to better understand the different scale characteristics in multimodal data, while fractional calculus provides a powerful mathematical tool for dealing with nonlinear and non-stationary problems. The support of digital technology and intelligent information systems makes the parameter estimation and training process of the model more accurate, and improves the ability to capture complex relationships in the knowledge graph. Through the wavelet - fractional multivariate grey prediction model, multimodal data can be analyzed more comprehensively, thereby providing a scientific basis and technical support for the construction of intelligent knowledge graphs.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Obtaining Head Motion Trajectory in High-Speed Collision Based on Euler Equation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The motion trajectory of dummy in automobile collision test is one of the important indexes to evaluate the risk of dummy collision injury. Generally, it is obtained by the second integration of the acceleration curve of the dummy's head, but the calculation result of this double integration method for the movement of the big rotating head dummy is very inaccurate. Therefore, this paper puts forward a calculation method of head motion trajectory based on Euler kinematics equation algorithm. The collision simulation model of the test vehicle is established, and the correctness of the algorithm is verified by the frontal collision simulation test, which can be used to extract the head trajectory.

articleTitle: Research on New Power Standard System Planning Method Based on UAF Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a new power standard system planning method based on Unified architecture framework (UAF), which aims to integrate the existing dispersed standard resources from a systematic perspective and promote the interconnection and collaborative operation of power systems. The research first analyzes the challenges of current power system standardization, including fragmentation of standards, lagging updates, and mismatch with new technologies. Then this paper introduces the basic principle and characteristics of UAF, and expounds how to use the cross-domain modeling ability of UAF to build the logical structure and function module of the power system standard system. Then, this paper puts forward a set of detailed planning steps, including requirement analysis, architecture design, standard formulation and evaluation feedback, etc., to ensure that the standard system can meet the current business needs, but also has good scalability and foresight. The empirical research shows that the UAF-based planning method can effectively integrate and optimize the existing standards, and form a set of hierarchical and comprehensive standard system. The system not only helps to improve the operational efficiency and reliability of the power system, but also provides a solid supporting framework for the development and innovation of future technologies. The research results of this paper have important theoretical value and practical significance for promoting the standardization process of power system, accelerating the energy transformation and the construction of smart grid.

articleTitle: AI-Based Models for Predicting and Preventing Car Accidents in Self-Driving Cars
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study aims to explore the potential of autonomous vehicles to reduce accidents by applying artificial intelligence models. Through machine learning and artificial intelligence, vehicles can detect potential risks and make decisions to prevent accidents. Specifically, this study focuses on three types of artificial intelligence models—VGGNet, ResNet, and CNN, and evaluates their effectiveness in predicting car accidents based on visual data. These models process input images from the car's vision system to predict the likelihood of an accident, which helps the driver take necessary measures in time to avoid the accident. The findings of this study could provide valuable insights into the integration of AI-driven systems in autonomous vehicles, ultimately contributing to safer driving environments and reducing the number of traffic-related accidents. Through the predictive capabilities of artificial intelligence models, road accidents can be effectively reduced and overall traffic safety can be improved in the future.

articleTitle: Research on the Resource Allocation Optimization Model of Automobile Based on Cloud Computing Resource Scheduling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a global resource allocation optimization model based on cloud computing, aiming to improve the global resource management efficiency of automobile enterprises through cloud computing resource scheduling algorithm. The system makes full use of the flexibility and scalability of cloud computing, and designs a set of advanced resource scheduling algorithms, which can dynamically adjust the allocation of computing resources according to the changes in demand in different markets and regions around the world, ensuring that resources can be optimally configured at different times and regions. The simulation results show that the model has significantly improved the resource allocation efficiency compared with traditional methods, which not only greatly improves the resource utilization rate, but also effectively reduces the operating costs of enterprises. The cloud computing resource scheduling algorithm shows higher computing efficiency and economic benefits when dealing with complex resource allocation problems. Compared with the traditional static scheduling method, the algorithm proposed in this paper shows its excellent adaptability when dealing with fluctuations in global resource demand, and provides a new technical path and practical basis for the resource allocation optimization of automobile enterprises in the context of globalization.

articleTitle: Research on Cargo Volume Prediction in Logistics Sorting Centers Based on ARIMA-LSTM Forecasting Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper presents a study on the prediction of cargo volumes in 57 logistics sorting centers using the ARIMA-LSTM forecasting algorithm. The primary objective is to forecast the volume of goods for the next thirty days as well as hourly predictions. The suitability of the ARIMA forecasting model is initially assessed by employing q-q plots and the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test to determine the data distribution. Subsequently, the LSTM forecasting model is integrated to enhance the accuracy of predictions. Following the prediction process, the presence of errors in the generated forecasts is evaluated through visual analysis. Any identified errors are then subject to fuzzy correction to improve the overall precision of the predictions.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic motion pattern recognition and analysis algorithm based on artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper focuses on the dynamic motion pattern recognition and analysis algorithm based on artificial intelligence, and proposes an innovative motion pattern recognition method, which combines fast Fourier transform (FFT) and fusion random forest model. Firstly, the motion signal is efficiently transformed from the time domain into the frequency domain through the application of the fast Fourier transform, enabling the extraction of key frequency characteristics, thereby enhancing the recognition capability of the motion pattern. The accuracy and stability of the model are subsequently enhanced by integrating the outputs from multiple decision trees, leveraging the power of the fusion random forest algorithm. In the random forest decision algorithm, the integrated learning strategy is introduced, which realizes the deficiency of single decision tree and further improves the classification performance of motion patterns. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that this method exhibits outstanding performance across various motion pattern recognition tasks, coupled with remarkable real-time capabilities and precision. This research provides a new idea and method for the field of motion pattern recognition, which has important theoretical value and practical application prospect.

articleTitle: Cargo Forecasting and Staff Scheduling Model Based on BP Neural Network Model and Integer Programming
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, the first prediction is made through BP neural network model. And according to the graph and related data, it is found that the prediction results can be well in line with the trend, and the prediction results are more accurate. Finally, according to the discrete nature of scheduling personnel and constraints, a scheduling model based on integer planning is established, and reasonable scheduling of employees is realized under the conditions of the given data. In further validation, by changing the parameter definitions, decision variables, objective functions and constraints, it is possible to verify whether the attendance rate of employees and the number of employees attending every day meet the requirements according to the actual data, which reflects the better applicability of the model in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Machine-Readable Capability Level and Capability Requirements of Power Grid Standards
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study takes the readability level and capability requirements of power grid standard machines as the theme, and deeply explores the transformation of relevant data forms in the process of power standard digitization and its impact on digital standards. By constructing an algorithm framework based on machine-readable standards, the study proposes a digital transformation technology route suitable for the power grid environment. This technology route evaluates the operating efficiency and data processing accuracy of power grid standard machines at different readability levels through system simulation. The simulation results show that the power digital standard using machine-readable standards has significant advantages in improving data transmission efficiency and reducing error rate. Specific data analysis shows that at high readability levels, the accuracy of the system is improved to more than 98%, and the response speed is 30% higher than that of traditional digital methods. This study provides new ideas for the digital transformation of power grid standard machines and lays a solid foundation for the promotion of machine-readable standards in the power industry in the future.

articleTitle: Distributed Power and Charging Infrastructure Carrying Capacity Evaluation Model Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a distributed power and charging infrastructure carrying capacity evaluation model based on big data, aiming to solve the growing power demand and charging infrastructure load pressure. The model is based on the concept of robust carrying capacity, and by integrating Wasserstein fuzzy set theory, it realizes the carrying capacity evaluation of distributed power and charging infrastructure in an uncertain environment. The algorithm in this paper first preprocesses large-scale data, constructs carrying capacity evaluation indicators through cluster analysis and fuzzy logic, and performs fuzzy set operations based on Wasserstein distance. The system simulation part uses real data to verify the model, and through multi-scenario simulation analysis, it shows the performance of the model under different load conditions. The simulation results show that the proposed model has good robustness in dealing with different charging demands and uneven distribution of distributed power sources, and the evaluation error is controlled within a reasonable range. The data analysis results show that compared with traditional methods, the model has significant advantages in improving evaluation accuracy and adaptability.

articleTitle: Prediction and Optimisation Models for Carbon Trading Prices - A Study Based on BP Neural Networks and Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel framework for an in-depth examination of carbon storage, integrating a genetic algorithm-backpropagation (GA-BP) approach with a greedy algorithm, based on empirical research into the optimization methods that combine genetic algorithms, neural networks, and greedy algorithms. A carbon prediction model utilizing a BP neural network is developed, focusing on domestic and international indicators, technical indicators, and exchange rates, alongside lagging macro indicators. Additionally, an optimization model for carbon storage prediction is established using a GA-BP neural network, enhanced and advanced through the LSTM method. The findings indicate that the model exhibits substantial robustness and attains relatively stable performance across varied market conditions, thereby enhancing efficiency and accuracy, fostering further advancements in carbon storage, offering strategic guidance for producers, and advancing traditional carbon storage towards a more efficient, transparent, and intelligent future.

articleTitle: Intelligent Algorithm for Aviation Flight Prediction and Dynamic Flight Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of the aviation industry, flight prediction and dynamic adjustment are crucial in aviation operation management. Flight delay is one of the main problems faced by airlines and passengers. Flight delays are caused by a combination of multiple factors, which require comprehensive consideration and analysis to develop effective measures to reduce the occurrence of flight delays. To address this issue, machine learning algorithms can be used to predict flight delays. This article utilizes a gradient boosting framework and combines multi-dimensional data such as historical flight data, weather information, and airport operations to design a flight delay prediction model. This model can accurately predict the possibility of flight delays through training and learning, providing strong support for airlines to formulate response strategies in advance. The experimental results showed that the continuously optimized prediction unit system in this article reduced the average absolute error by 2.54 minutes and the average root mean square error by 1.64 minutes under all windows. It can be shown that the prediction model in this paper has high accuracy in predicting flight dynamics.

articleTitle: Research on Submarine Position Prediction and Search and Rescue Strategy Based on Kalman Filter and Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this study, we propose a hybrid model combining dynamic modeling, Bayesian networks, and particle swarm optimization (PSO) for accurate submarine position prediction and efficient search and rescue operations. The dynamic model, grounded in Newtonian mechanics, provides a foundational framework for simulating submarine movements. The Bayesian network is employed to assess the probability of the submarine's presence at various locations, integrating uncertainty in environmental factors. The Kalman filter further enhances the predictive accuracy by managing noise and refining trajectory estimates. Finally, PSO is utilized to optimize the search process, demonstrating rapid convergence towards the most probable locations. This integrated approach offers a robust solution for underwater operations, as validated through extensive simulations.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's disease MRI image recognition method based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Globally, the incidence of Alzheimer's disease is increasing. Although there are many diagnostic methods, traditional methods often rely on professional knowledge and consume much time. Therefore, there is an urgent need to introduce automated technology to improve diagnostic efficiency and accuracy. This study used three deep learning models, namely convolutional neural network (CNN), ResNet, and VGGNet. It optimized them according to data characteristics for Alzheimer's MRI image recognition, providing a reference for diagnosing Alzheimer's disease. This study used the dataset from Dataset Alzheimer, based on the data preprocessing of Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI). The model was trained after the dataset was processed by data augmentation, pixel value scaling and MOTE oversampling. The experimental results indicated that the VGGNet model attained the highest overall accuracy at 76%, and the CNN and ResNet models reached accuracies of 75% and 74%, respectively. Nonetheless, the model's proficiency in reliably identifying categories with limited samples necessitates enhancement. Furthermore, further analysis is necessary to assess the model's generalisation potential and its relevance in clinical environments. Future research may explore more advanced model architectures, incorporating attention processes and generative adversarial networks (GANs), to enhance the model's recognition capabilities and its suitability for therapeutic applications.

articleTitle: Research on multi-objective optimization model of enterprise performance evaluation based on big data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: ]In the enterprise performance evaluation driven by big data, how to effectively extract key features from massive data and carry out multi-objective optimization is an important topic of current research. In this paper, an innovative Recursive Feature Multi-Objective Evolutionary (RFMOE) algorithm is proposed, which combines the advantages of recursive feature elimination (RFE) and decomposition based multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (MOEA/D). In the multi-objective optimization model of enterprise performance evaluation based on big data, RFMOE first utilizes the iterative feature selection mechanism of RFE to effectively eliminate redundant and unimportant features, reduce data dimensions, and improve model efficiency. Then, the multi-objective optimization problem is decomposed into multiple single-objective subproblems by MOEA/D, and the information exchange of adjacent subproblems is used to optimize the solution process to obtain a set of Pareto optimal solutions. Finally, by comparing the model architecture with the traditional model, the results show that RFMOE has significant advantages in improving the evaluation accuracy, enhancing the robustness of the model and improving the decision-making efficiency, which provides a powerful tool for the performance management and strategic planning of enterprises. The feasibility and effectiveness of this model in enterprise performance evaluation are proved.

articleTitle: Research on the Model of Improving Engineering Safety Management Decision Support System Using Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the increasing scale and complexity of modern engineering projects, the challenges faced by engineering safety management are becoming increasingly severe. To address this problem, this paper proposes a model of engineering safety management decision support system based on data mining technology. The model uses advanced algorithms such as gradient boosting decision tree (GBDT) to extract valuable information from a large amount of engineering safety data to classify and predict potential risks. The system architecture consists of modules such as data preprocessing, risk identification, risk assessment and decision support, which can effectively improve the accuracy of risk identification. Through simulation tests on actual engineering project data sets, the risk prediction accuracy of the system model reached 92.5%, which is about 15% higher than that of traditional methods. In addition, the system shows good generalization ability in different engineering scenarios, reducing the impact of human factors on safety management decisions. Experimental results show that the system cannot only help engineering managers identify high-risk areas, but also provide optimized safety management decision suggestions, significantly improving the safety of engineering projects. The research in this paper shows that the data-driven engineering safety management model provides a new decision support means for the field of engineering management.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Breast Cancer Probability Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Breast cancer, as the most common cancer among women globally, the key to improving its efficacy lies in early detection and diagnosis. Currently, breast cancer screening mainly relies on mammography, but this technology alone cannot accurately screen for breast cancer, leading to potential misdiagnoses. For breast cancer, the key to improving prognosis and survival rate is early detection. Additionally, breast cancer patients can significantly extend their survival time and improve their quality of life through good prognosis analysis. Therefore, this study focuses on the early diagnosis and prognosis analysis of breast cancer, applying machine learning and data analysis techniques combined with statistical analysis methods to analyze existing clinical data and achieve a high-accuracy disease analysis judgment for breast cancer. This study explores the effectiveness of applying various machine learning models in breast cancer prediction. This study used classic algorithms such as K-nearest neighbors, support vector machine, and Bayesian classifier, and conducted detailed data preprocessing and analysis. In this study, the breast cancer dataset was trained in different models respectively. The obtained evaluation results such as the prediction accuracy were compared to select the machine learning model with the best performance. It can be known from the final experiment that KNN model performs best on the dataset, followed by the SVM and KNN models. This study not only demonstrates the potential of machine learning in medical diagnosis but also provides important references for further optimizing breast cancer prediction models in the future.

articleTitle: Research on digital advertising precision delivery system based on reinforcement learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study proposes a new reinforcement learning framework for Trans-Proximal Policy (TPP), which aims to combine the advantages of Transformer network and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to realize efficient and precise digital advertising. TPP uses the powerful sequence processing capability of Transformer network to capture historical patterns of user behavior, and combines the efficient policy optimization algorithm of PPO to achieve fast and stable policy learning. In the digital advertising scenario, TPP can capture the user's historical behavior sequence data to predict the future interaction probability, and optimize the advertising strategy accordingly. Finally, through comparative experiments and analysis between the model framework and traditional optimization algorithms, this paper verifies that the TPP proposed in this paper can significantly improve the click-through rate, accuracy rate and conversion rate of advertisements while maintaining the stability of policy update, especially in the processing of large-scale user behavior data. This model is proved to be feasible and effective in the digital advertising precision delivery system.

articleTitle: Research on Automobile Export Big Data Analysis Algorithm Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes an automobile export prediction algorithm based on big data analysis, combined with advanced machine learning technology, to achieve accurate analysis and prediction of global automobile export data. The core of the algorithm is to use a hierarchical clustering algorithm to classify and process automobile export data from different regions and markets, thereby improving the efficiency and accuracy of data processing. Through feature extraction and data preprocessing steps, the algorithm constructs a prediction model that can flexibly adapt to different market needs and can be optimized for different market conditions. The model is not only simulated and verified on multiple real-world automobile export data sets, but also combined with statistical methods to conduct a comprehensive and accurate analysis of the simulation results. The simulation data shows that the prediction algorithm proposed in this paper not only shows extremely high computational efficiency when processing large-scale data sets and complex market environments, but also significantly outperforms existing traditional algorithms in terms of prediction accuracy. Especially in the face of volatile demand in different economies, the algorithm demonstrates its strong adaptability and prediction capabilities.

articleTitle: Comparison of GIS fault testing methods based on product detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In response to the imperative for monitoring decomposition products in C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>N/CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> mixtures employed in eco-friendly gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), this study elucidates a sophisticated detection methodology anchored in the spectral characteristics of these byproducts. In this manuscript, a suite of controlled experiments, leveraging the analytical prowess of Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR) and Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS), is presented to identify and quantify the decomposition products. The empirical findings reveal a plethora of compounds, encompassing carbon oxides and carbon fluorides, each bearing distinct spectral signatures. articleTitle: Aircraft trajectory planning based on threat sources in uncertain environments
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Combat aircraft face dynamic threats in adversarial non deterministic space environments. In response to the trajectory planning problem of combat aircraft in uncertain environments, a mathematical model for aircraft trajectory planning was first constructed based on the characteristics of threats. An improved genetic algorithm based on predatory search strategy was used for planning, and the feasibility and effectiveness of the model and algorithm were verified through simulation.

articleTitle: Research and application of key technology of high speed laser clearance of tree obstacles on transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Transmission line tree obstacles pose a great threat to the safe operation of power system. Laser obstacle clearance technology provides a new way for remote tree obstacles removal, but the existing technology and products have shortcomings in efficiency and speed, and the clearance efficiency is greatly affected by personnel experience. High efficiency and high speed clearance of tree obstacles is the focus and difficulty of current work. Aiming at the requirements of engineering applications, the laser active dynamic focusing technology was developed to realize the dynamic focusing fast cutting function with high power density, and the influence of remote cutting mode on the clearance efficiency of tree obstacles was explored. Based on video and image AI technology, real-time breakdown judgment and automatic cutting are realized to solve the efficiency problems caused by experience and human misjudgment. The prototype equipment is developed and the engineering test is carried out. The results show that the efficiency of the laser high-speed obstacle clearance system based on laser dynamic focusing technology and AI technology is twice than that of the traditional obstacle clearance products, and it has broad engineering application prospects.

articleTitle: Research on Advanced Digital Model of Regional Manufacturing Export Based on Computer Aided Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, a new computational intelligence method is proposed to optimize the organizational decision process in industrial automation. The approach studied in this paper utilizes advanced machine learning algorithms to analyze real-time sensor data and predict system failures before they occur, enabling proactive maintenance and reducing downtime. In this paper, a multi-agent system is designed to work with the traditional manufacturing control system to improve the decision-making ability. The architecture of the system is specifically tailored to deal with the complexity and dynamics of modern industrial environments, where fast response times and accurate forecasting are critical to maintaining operational efficiency and product quality. Major contributions of this paper’s research include the development of a hybrid machine learning model that combines deep learning with evolutionary optimization techniques to improve prediction accuracy, and the integration of this model into a multi-agent system that can adapt to changing environmental conditions and evolve over time to maintain optimal decision performance.

articleTitle: Ranging-based Modeling and Simulation of Target Locating Error of EO Payload
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Target locating is one of the most important applications of UAV. Minimizing locating errors and improving positioning accuracy are an important direction for UAV target locating. The article illustrates UAV positioning featuring low speed and low altitude, the error solution modeling under general conditions is established through error analysis of spatial multi-point positioning system. The major direct error sources, such as calculation error, satellite-based positioning error, and optical axis error, are analyzed, among which the satellite navigation positioning error is a linear error while the error caused by ranging is an nonlinear error. Meanwhile, considering the different target locating and reconnaissance missions of the UAV, this article simulates the target locating error at the relative flying altitude of 500m~6000m and the operating range of 1000m-8000m. The simulation results are consistent with the actual flight verification results. The error model provides an effective solution for efficient and rapid target locating of the UAV.

articleTitle: Improved GMM High-Resolution Remote Sensing Image Land Cover Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: To address the increased complexity of surface cover, increased heterogeneity within homogeneous regions, and increased similarity between different regions in high-resolution remote sensing images, which lead to increased classification difficulty, a supervised learning method based on a double neighborhood relationship Gaussian Regression Mixture Model (GRMM) is proposed. Firstly, supervised sampling of image regions is conducted, fitting histograms using the least squares method to establish Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM) for each land cover to represent the complex gray-scale features of land cover. Secondly, local spatial information of adjacent pixels is introduced into the image gray-scale space to construct a Gaussian Regression Model (GRM). Finally, in the membership degree space, the neighborhood relationship is processed again to achieve classification decision. The kappa coefficients of GRMM on synthetic images and real high-resolution remote sensing images respectively reaches 97.2% and 98.5%. Compared to existing mainstream models, GRMM demonstrates strong classification efficiency, noise reduction capability, and generalization ability, with clear classification boundaries, effectively improved the land cover classification capability of remote sensing images.

articleTitle: The Application of Multi-physics Coupling in Deformation Sensing and Control of Soft Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In recent years, the applications of small-scale and soft robots in various tasks have significantly increased. However, traditional control systems have been proven no longer competent for further use due to neglecting material deformation, a vital factor for these new robotic systems. This paper focuses on developing a novel approach for detecting material deformation that can be applied to establish better-suited control systems for soft robots. Using COMSOL Multiphysics simulation software and coding software, a coupling between solid mechanics and electric current fields can be created to investigate the relationship between deformation and voltage changes. Based on the data generated from the simulation, it is aimed at discovering relationships that exist between the deformation and processible electrical signals. The experiment results demonstrate that the proposed approach can successfully reveal the expected relationship and possess the potential to form the conversion between deformation and electrical signals intended for use in control systems. This research provides a novel approach to upgrading the control system for soft robots, with promising applications in control scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Data-Driven Optimization Model of Fuel Cell Hydrogen Supply Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a data-driven optimization model for fuel cell hydrogen supply network, aiming to improve the overall efficiency of the supply network by analyzing actual data. The model uses a hybrid heuristic algorithm to optimize each node in the network, taking into account multiple variables in the supply chain, such as hydrogen production, transportation costs, and demand fluctuations. Through algorithm design and model simulation, this paper conducts an in-depth study on network optimization under different configurations, and verifies the effectiveness of the model with precise data analysis. The findings indicate that within limitations, the proposed model successfully attains an optimal balance between the effectiveness and cost-efficiency of hydrogen distribution. The developed optimization framework demonstrates its capability to significantly lower supply chain expenditures, enhance the dependability and robustness of the system, and furnish a strong foundation for the extensive deployment of fuel cells. The optimization model devised in this study, along with its simulated outcomes, offers substantial reference value for the design and enhancement of prospective hydrogen supply infrastructures.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Recognizing Book Titles Based on Paddle OCR
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This article explores the book title recognition method based on Paddle OCR. Utilizing the Baidu AI Studio platform and Paddle OCR tool, an effective book title recognition scheme is proposed. This scheme employs the PP- OCRv4 model, combined with text detection based on the Differentiable Binarization algorithm and a text recognition model based on the SVTR_LCNet lightweight text recognition network, to achieve effective recognition of book titles. To enhance the generalization ability of the model, this paper investigates image enhancement methods such as random rotation, random flipping, and adjusting image contrast and brightness. After data augmentation, the accuracy of model recognition has been improved. In the data preprocessing stage, steps such as grayscale transformation and bilateral filtering are employed to reduce invalid information in the image and enhance the prediction efficiency of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Software Supply Chain Security Assurance Mechanism System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This research introduces a security assurance mechanism for the software supply chain, leveraging blockchain technology to address existing vulnerabilities within the supply chain. The inherent decentralized and tamper-resistant features of blockchain offer robust safeguards for data exchanges across various stages of the supply chain. The system incorporates an enhanced Byzantine fault-tolerance algorithm to improve the network's resilience, ensuring that supply chain nodes can maintain efficient operation even in complex and challenging environments. For critical security aspects within the supply chain, specialized algorithms and models have been devised, and the system's security and performance are validated through simulation models. The simulation outcomes demonstrate that the system exhibits strong resilience against attacks and potential threats to the software supply chain, while also maintaining high operational efficiency alongside its security measures. Data analysis reveals that the implementation of this security assurance mechanism significantly elevates the overall safety and stability of the software supply chain. The findings of this study provide a theoretical foundation and technical framework for enhancing security assurance capabilities in software supply chains.

articleTitle: Research on Aviation Route Optimization Model Based on Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of aviation route optimization in constructing an aviation network model, the specification of air traffic control protocols, data acquisition and preprocessing, the design of dynamic programming model structure, algorithm training, and parameter optimization, and proposes a dynamic programming-based aviation route optimization algorithm. First, according to the aviation network model and the aviation route optimization, we obtain information about the traffic and capacity of key nodes and segments. Second, we propose a strategy for dynamically adjusting aviation routes to eliminate the congestion of aviation routes. Third, a dynamic programming model is developed to accurately depict the optimization problem of aviation routes, considering the impact of traffic flow, weather, and control protocol based on the dynamic nature of air traffic flow. Finally, this study builds an aviation route optimization system based on a dynamic programming algorithm. Simulation and experiment prove the effectiveness of the proposed dynamic programming algorithm.

articleTitle: Intelligent Design of VR Systems for Immersive Human-Computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study aims to enhance the interaction experience and immersion of virtual reality (VR) systems. By designing and implementing an intelligent algorithm-based VR interaction system, innovative technologies such as user intent recognition, gesture and eye-tracking, multi-sensory coordination optimization, and adaptive experience adjustment are integrated. A prototype system was developed, and rigorous experimental design and multidimensional evaluation methods were used to verify significant improvements in interaction accuracy, response speed, and user immersion. The experimental results not only confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed approach but also provided new insights into the future development of VR technology. Although there are some limitations, this study has made significant contributions to the development of VR technology towards a more intelligent, natural, and immersive direction, laying a technical foundation for the widespread application of VR.

articleTitle: Research on personalized intelligence model of artificial intelligence in automobile digital marketing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the acceleration of the digital transformation of the automotive industry, personalized marketing plays an increasingly significant role in improving user experience and boosting sales conversion rate. This paper proposes a personalized intelligent model of automobile digital marketing based on artificial intelligence, and focuses on the application of autoencoder algorithm in user data processing and feature extraction. Through dimensionality reduction and compression of extensive user data, the autoencoder efficiently extracts hidden features, thereby significantly enhancing the precision of personalized recommendations. This paper combines K-means clustering and Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithms for a comparative performance analysis. Experimental results indicate that while K-means clustering exhibits strong performance in user group classification, and Support Vector Machines demonstrate high accuracy in solving classification problems, the overall model's recommendation accuracy and user behavior prediction ability are further enhanced when integrated with the autoencoder, with an accuracy rate increase of approximately 12.5%. The simulation results indicate that the autoencoder algorithm achieves efficient data compression and feature learning in large-scale automotive data marketing systems, offering more precise personalized recommendations and marketing strategies for automotive digital marketing systems.

articleTitle: Research on Building Form Energy Saving Design Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of urbanization, the thermal environment quality and energy consumption of urban residential space have been paid more and more attention, which makes energy-saving planning and design and energy-saving building design become the focus of current research. However, due to the limited computing power and insufficient consideration of form factors, there are relatively few studies on the impact of building group form on building energy consumption. Therefore, this paper adopts the machine learning framework based on convolutional neural network to analyze the influence of building group shape on its overall building energy consumption under the action of various form factors, and verifies that different building group shape factor layout in residential areas can be obtained by changing the combined control factors under different plot ratio and building density control conditions. The results show that building energy consumption can be significantly changed by changing the form factors of building groups. The research in this paper provides an energy-saving oriented design method and analysis process of residential building group form, and provides corresponding methods and suggestions for energy-saving building design, energy-saving planning and design, which guides building energy-saving design.

articleTitle: Comparing Graph Neural Networks Aggregation Strategies for Dynamic Programming-Based Reasoning Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper investigates the reasoning capabilities of various Graph Neural Networks (GNN) on dynamic programming-based tasks, focusing on the impact of different aggregation strategies. The study evaluates five GNN architectures, Message Passing Neural Networks, Graph Convolutional Networks, Graph Attention Networks, Graph Sample and Aggregation, and Graph Isomorphism Networks—across three DP problems: Longest Increasing Subsequence (LIS), Coin Change, and 0/1 Knapsack. These tasks challenge the GNNs to simulate discrete functions and implicitly learn correct logical reasoning steps. Experiments are conducted to assess the reasoning accuracy and generalization ability of GNNs. The results demonstrate that GraphSAGE consistently outperforms other models in the LIS problem for relational understanding. However, all models struggle with the NP-Hard integer programming problem Coin Change, highlighting the need for more expressive aggregation mechanisms. This study provides theoretical insights into the effect of different GNN designs for algorithmic reasoning tasks. It suggests directions for future research, including exploring more algorithmic challenges and the influence of advanced network structure.

articleTitle: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Solving Math Word Problems: A Case Study with LLaMA-3
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to advances in natural language processing, but handling mathematical tasks remains a challenge due to the demands of text understanding, quantitative reasoning, and numerical computation. Although LLMs show progress in reasoning for simpler problems, they often struggle with more complex tasks requiring multi-step reasoning. To address these challenges, this study focuses on fine-tuning a pre-trained Llama-3-8B-Chinese-Chat model to enhance its ability to solve mathematical word problems (MWPs). A systematic approach was followed, involving dataset difficulty classification, prompt engineering, and LoRA fine-tuning techniques. The model's performance was evaluated to show significant improvements in equation matching and numerical accuracy after fine-tuning, particularly for complex problems. On simple, medium, and difficult test sets, End-to-End accuracy of fine-tuned model improved by 47.1%, 30.2%, and 65.7% correspondingly. However, the model still fails to reach a satisfactory accuracy while handling purely mathematical computations, which may be accounted for its poor capability of handling symbol processing and fraction conversion. Future research directions include investigating diverse mathematical reasoning tasks and integrating external symbolic computation tools to enhance computational precision. This study contributes to evaluating LLMs' mathematical reasoning capabilities and revealing the promising potential of LoRA fine-tuning.

articleTitle: Research on Film and Television Multimedia Fusion Analysis Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the development of science and technology and the emergence of complex film and television multimedia, the traditional single media analysis method can no longer meet the needs of automatically obtaining high-level media semantic content. This paper mainly uses the computer to automatically analyze and extract the abstract semantic content of film and television multimedia data. At the same time, it conducts in-depth research on various related technologies of film and television multimedia integration, discusses the analysis methods of film and television multimedia integration, focuses on the research of the scene detection algorithm combining sound and image, and establishes the architecture and model of the multimedia integrated analysis system. The research of this paper has certain reference significance for the analysis of multimedia content of film and television.

articleTitle: Application of Improved One-Dimensional Convolutional Neural Network in Tunnel Surrounding Rock Deformation Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: To address the inherent limitations of traditional forecasting methods in the context of complex geological environments, this study introduces a novel and enhanced one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) tailored specifically for predicting tunnel surrounding rock deformation. By meticulously refining the architecture of the convolutional and pooling layers, the proposed model significantly augments its ability to extract and interpret intricate features from time-series data, thereby improving prediction accuracy. The research encompasses a comprehensive system framework that includes algorithm development and optimization, model training, validation, and rigorous system simulation. During the simulation phase, an extensive array of datasets comprising real-world tunnel surrounding rock measurements is employed to thoroughly evaluate the model's predictive accuracy and robustness, benchmarking it against conventional approaches. The simulation results demonstrate that the upgraded model achieves superior performance, with the mean error reduced by more than 15% compared to traditional methods, highlighting its enhanced stability and reliability. Detailed data analysis further validates the algorithm's broad applicability across diverse geological conditions, offering substantial technical support for real-time monitoring and early warning systems in tunnel engineering. This study not only contributes to the advancement of predictive modeling techniques but also provides a robust foundation for future research in optimizing tunnel stability under varying geological conditions.

Author Keywords: Improved one-dimensional convolutional neural network algorithm

articleTitle: Research on Smoke Image Recognition: Multi-Scale Dilated Convolutional Neural Network and Entropy Function Threshold
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: For the application of artificial intelligence in image-based smoke detection in emergency management, this paper proposes an image recognition algorithm based on a multi-scale dilated convolutional neural network and entropy threshold function to prevent the loss of small-scale features, low detection rate, and poor real-time performance of smoke image recognition. First, the smoke features are determined according to a multi-scale analysis model, and multi-scale information such as texture, color, and shape of the smoke image is obtained. Second, we propose a dilated convolutional neural network to solve the feature loss. Third, according to the characteristics of the entropy function, we build a model that comprehensively considers smoke features and recognition thresholds, which more accurately describes the image recognition process. Ultimately, this research develops a smoke detection system using the suggested algorithm and demonstrates its efficacy through simulation and experimental validation.

articleTitle: Laboratory detection technology of transformer winding deformation based on frequency response curve difference
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The winding deformation is one of the common defects of power transformers. Frequency response analysis (FRA) can be used to detect the change of the internal geometry of transformers. In this paper, the frequency response curve of the internal winding is compared with the reference response characteristic curve, and the deformation detection of the internal winding of the power transformer is realized based on the difference analysis. The feasibility of detecting axial displacement and radial deformation between windings with different connection modes is proved by simulation and simulation.

articleTitle: Research on the Integrated Model Construction of Business Perspective and IT System Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper discusses "Research on the integrated model construction of business perspective and IT system monitoring", aiming to solve the problem of system monitoring from the marketing business perspective under the background of the surge in the number of core business applications. In the face of the real-time and stable requirements of business scenarios such as marketing industry expansion, customer service, measurement management, and expense management, this paper proposes an innovative method combining deep Q network integration and Dung Beetle optimization (DBO) algorithm to achieve the unity of perspectives of business personnel and technical personnel and ensure the close connection between business and IT system. Then the performance of the model is improved by hyperparameter optimization. Then, this paper deeply analyzes the panoramic monitoring technologies such as logging, performance monitoring and anomaly detection, and explores the way to quickly locate faults, with a special focus on the impact of microservices and cloud-native technologies on business stability in marketing 2.0 systems, as well as solutions to operational challenges. The simulation results show accurate data analysis, demonstrate the stability of the model under high loads and abnormal conditions, and effectively monitor a variety of objects including networks, physical machines, applications, and clients. This method can effectively deal with the operation and maintenance challenges under the complex cloud system architecture, and provide a comprehensive and efficient monitoring scheme for the marketing 2.0 system.

articleTitle: Power User Behavior and Load Forecasting Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the improvement of power system intelligence and the development of power collection technology, a huge amount of power data is generated. This data includes the number of times of electricity consumption, time of electricity consumption, electricity equipment and other users' electricity consumption behaviours. In this paper, a set of power consumption behavior analysis model based on power big data was constructed, which helped to deeply understand the characteristics and behavioral laws of users' power consumption, and provided important support for the energysaving management and optimization of China's power grid enterprises. Traditional research on electricity consumption behaviour mainly relies on small-sample research and simple statistical analysis, which cannot completely and accurately grasp electricity consumption behaviour. However, the electric power consumption collection and analysis model based on electric power big data, with its large data scale, multiple dimensions, wide coverage and high accuracy, can study users' electricity consumption behaviour from a finer and more comprehensive perspective. In this paper, a user electricity consumption behaviour analysis model based on electricity big data was introduced, and the K-SVD (K-Singular Value Decomposition) algorithm was used to decompose the user's electricity consumption patterns in order to extract the user's electricity consumption characteristics and behavioural patterns. The experimental results showed that the K-SVD algorithm was able to predict the power consumption of users more accurately, and the prediction error was small, usually between 1-2 kWh. Load prediction based on the K-SVD algorithm shows high efficiency and stability in practical applications, providing strong support for energy management and optimization.

articleTitle: Optimization design of high-voltage circuit breaker cam based on equivalent dynamic model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The cam is an integral component of circuit breaker actuation mechanisms, directly influencing the breaker's dynamic characteristics. Current cam designs largely rely on empirical methods, often failing to meet the specific design requirements of the circuit breaker itself, resulting in poor closing performance. To address this issue, this study first establishes an equivalent dynamic model based on moving contacts, effectively simplifying the closing motion of the circuit breaker. Building upon this equivalent dynamic model, an iterative instantaneous gear ratio method is proposed to design the cam for achieving target stroke and velocity profiles. Using the results from this method, an optimization model for closing action based on genetic algorithms is developed, resolving issues of excessive closing operation energy and optimizing the breaker's dynamic characteristics. Validation through simulations based on the developed models shows that the designed cam ensures the circuit breaker's closing time and velocity remain within specified design ranges, demonstrating the feasibility of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised Learning Based Entity Recognition Method for Power Dispatch Operation Statements
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the continuous development of the power grid, power grid dispatching faces the problems of complicated business data, inefficient information retrieval and time-consuming operation ticket preparation. The existing operation ticket generation method has been difficult to meet the safe operation of the power grid, and the time-consuming retrieval of the paper dispatch manual has led to the difficulty of efficient retrieval of the dispatch response programme and the inefficiency of the operation ticket preparation. In order to shorten the time consuming operation ticket generation and improve the efficiency of dispatchers, it is necessary to accurately identify the entities of key operation statements such as power dispatch operation steps, equipment, operation time, etc. in the operation ticket document to improve the retrieval efficiency. Therefore, this paper proposes a deep entity recognition model based on scheduling operation statements, which firstly employs a pre-training model, ERNIE, to capture entity-level semantic information, and secondly explores the entity recognition knowledge in the unlabelled data through the proposed semi-supervised training architecture and the loss function scheduling mechanism, so as to improve the performance of the power scheduling entity recognition. In order to verify the effectiveness of this approach, experiments are conducted in this paper using the power dispatch operation text dataset, and the experimental results show that the proposed semi-supervised power dispatch entity recognition method improves the entity recognition precision, recall and F1 score of power dispatch operation statements by 4.43%, 2.06% and 3.24%, respectively, under the full amount of annotated data, as compared to the previous optimal baseline based on fully supervised learning. 3.24%. In particular, with only 10% of labelled data, the F1 score is improved by 15.92% compared to the optimal baseline. These results fully demonstrate the effectiveness of mining knowledge from unlabelled text for power dispatch entity recognition.

articleTitle: Analysis of Malignant Brain Tumor Automated Detection by Artificial Intelligence and MRI Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: A brain tumor is a growth of abnormal cells around the brain. Brain tumors can be benign (not cancerous) or malignant (cancerous). Whether benign or malignant, brain tumors can damage surrounding tissues in the brain. In addition, tumors become increasingly harmful as they grow and their impact can depend on their location. For example, tumors found in the cerebellum can affect movement and tumors found in the optic nerve can affect vision. In this research we explored classifying malignant and benign tumors using artificial intelligence (AI) analysis with CNN, KNN, logistic regression, and stacking model. To accomplish this goal, we analyzed a dataset of MRI images containing images of both malignant and benign brain tumors. Furthermore, we increased the accuracy of malignant brain tumor detection by augmenting this dataset with information about lobe location of the tumors.

articleTitle: Design of Video English Teaching System Based on Computer 5G Technology and Advanced Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The high data latency in real-world applications makes the standard online training platform incompatible. As a result, online video-based English teaching system is created using computer algorithms and 5G wireless network communication technologies. The Multimedia English online teaching platform's overall architecture is created with the actual functional requirements of online instruction in mind. The main controller, memory, and data collector hardware are used in this architecture to create the platform. The software components can be separated into two sections according to 5G wireless network communication technology and advanced computer algorithms. It is composed of several useful modules. The administrator, teacher, and student submodules' primary tasks serve as the foundation for the creation of the platform's functional modules. Simultaneously, the analytic hierarchy method and the evaluation domain are combined to calculate the weight of the indicators and establish the quality evaluation of online multimedia English instruction. The platform design is finished with the level model. The experimental findings demonstrate that the platform's test results are following expectations and have the potential to significantly raise the standard and effectiveness of online video-based English instruction. The average teaching efficiency is 96.27%, and the quality of instruction is consistently greater than 95%.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of STFT and DWT in Audio Denoising
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper describes the basic idea about Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) as well as Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT). And we need to use the audio of a song as the example, test the performance of STFT and DWT on audio denoising. The experiment uses Matlab software as the tool, and several indices such as sound to noise ratio correlation coefficient are used to evaluate the performance. Several graphs are also drawn to get a clear view of the performance of denoise. The result shows that using STFT performs better than the DWT. The noise signal after STFT processing is very close to the original signal.

articleTitle: Development of an Enterprise Knowledge Base System Based on Elasticsearch
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the continuous increase in social demand, the scale and quantity of projects in enterprises are becoming larger and larger. This makes enterprises face the problem of dealing with a large number of complex documents in project work, as well as the problem of inefficient information sharing during personnel changes and document handover. Based on the problems faced, an enterprise knowledge base system was designed. This system adopts a front-end and back-end separation architecture, ensuring good scalability and flexibility. The system mainly has multiple functions such as user authentication, user management, tag management, project management, project member management, project document management, project data management, information retrieval function, and document robot. Among them, information retrieval and document robots are the core functions of the project. The information retrieval part uses Elasticsearch to store document information, and synchronizes the document information stored in MySQL to Elasticsearch through Logstash. The inverted index structure greatly improves the efficiency of full-text retrieval. The document robot module introduces retrieval enhanced generation technology, which combines the prompt word engineering and retrieval database provided by LangChain with a large language model to achieve intelligent question answering for documents. With the continuous deepening of enterprise informatization construction, this system will provide stronger support for the development of enterprises and provide an efficient solution for project management, which helps to improve the efficiency and quality of project management and has certain application scenarios and reference value.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Estimation Model of Carbon Stock of Rocky Desertification Plantations Based on LiDAR Point Cloud Data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes an intelligent estimation model of carbon stock of rocky desertification plantations based on LiDAR point cloud data. The model uses an advanced point cloud segmentation algorithm to finely segment the forest data collected by LiDAR, so as to accurately distinguish the vegetation type and density. Through the processing and feature extraction of point cloud data, combined with the geographical characteristics of rocky desertification areas, this study designed a carbon stock estimation algorithm model suitable for rocky desertification plantations. The system model includes modules such as data acquisition, point cloud segmentation, and carbon stock estimation, which are optimized by combining machine learning methods. The simulation part verifies the accuracy of the model through a large amount of field measurement data, and accurately estimates the carbon stock of different rocky desertification levels through quantitative analysis. The results show that the error rate of the model in carbon stock estimation is less than 5%, which has high application potential and practicality. The research in this paper provides an effective technical means for the accurate assessment of carbon stocks in rocky desertification areas, which will help further promote the implementation of carbon sink mechanisms and the restoration of ecosystems.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning Models Combining Transformer and BERT: Application in Network Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In response to the low recognition accuracy, complex preprocessing techniques, and unstable detection accuracy in network intrusion detection, this paper proposes a deep learning model based on the combination of Transformer and BERT. Firstly, based on the basic theories of Transformer and BERT, an intrusion detection model was established to obtain detailed information on network traffic characteristics, intrusion behavior types, and detection performance. Secondly, in order to eliminate the interference of these issues, a principal component analysis strategy was proposed. Furthermore, based on the characteristics of Transformer neural networks, an intrusion detection model was constructed that comprehensively considers the influence of network traffic characteristics and intrusion behavior types, providing a more accurate description of network intrusion behavior. Finally, an intrusion detection system based on Transformer and BERT was built, and the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm was verified through numerical examples.

articleTitle: Artificial Noise-like Covert Communication with Low Power Consumption and Low Complexity
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
