abstract: The broadcast characteristics of communication between wireless devices make the communication easy to be eavesdropped. This paper studies the covert communication transmission in the field of artificial noise. Based on the perfect sequence, a parameterized unitary matrix is generated and the modulation symbols are transformed. The symbols with obvious constellation mapping relationship are mapped to Gaussian noise. This method applies the full power to the transmitted symbol, while traditional artificial noise methods need to allocate part of the power to the manufactured noise. The proposed method has better performance in power consumption, Peak to Average Power Ratio (PAPR) performance and computational complexity.

articleTitle: Research and Design of a Fault Detection System for High-Band Wireless Communication Networks Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This manuscript explores the design and implementation of a fault detection system for high-band wireless communication networks, utilizing machine learning technologies. As 5G and future communication technologies evolve, high-frequency communications, such as millimeter waves and terahertz waves, reveal their substantial potential in various advanced applications. However, they also encounter significant technical challenges, especially in fault detection. Addressing these challenges, this study employs Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) to design a fault detection model that overcomes issues of sample imbalance and high dimensionality. The findings demonstrate that the proposed system effectively identifies and predicts network faults, enhancing the accuracy and timeliness of fault detection. This research not only offers a technological innovation but also provides a novel solution for the reliable operation and fault management of high-frequency communication networks, possessing significant academic and practical value.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction Model of Automobile Digital Marketing Effect Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study aims to develop an advanced prediction model that uses deep learning algorithms to estimate the effectiveness of automotive digital marketing activities. By combining the advantages of MLP, CNN and LSTM, a composite model is constructed to improve the accuracy of the prediction model. This study first constructs a systematic feature extraction and data preprocessing process, and uses the MLP algorithm to establish a preliminary framework of the prediction model. Furthermore, combining the powerful ability of CNN in feature recognition and the expertise of LSTM in processing time series data, an in-depth prediction analysis of the marketing effect is performed. Through a series of experiments and model simulation verification, the study found that the proposed hybrid model shows high accuracy in multidimensional data prediction tasks. The simulation results not only provide accurate data analysis, but also confirm the applicability and advantages of the model in a changing marketing environment. Finally, through comparative analysis with traditional prediction methods, this paper further verifies the effectiveness and broad application prospects of deep learning technology in the field of automotive digital marketing effect prediction.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Weather Recognition Using ResNet-50 and a Novel Weather Image Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Weather conditions play a crucial role in both daily human activities and industrial operations. For example, recognizing different weather patterns is critical for outdoor automation systems. With the development of AI technology, scientific researchers have trained many models which receive weather images as inputs and output the weather in these images fast and accurately. However, many existing weather recognition models are limited in scope, typically identifying only four types of weather with varying degrees of accuracy. In this study, the two key contributions of this research are: first, the creation of a custom dataset designed specifically for recognizing seven distinct weather conditions, and second, the exploration of multiple machine learning techniques to identify the most effective model for this task. By developing our own dataset, we ensure a broader representation of weather types, allowing the models to train and be tested on more diverse and realistic scenarios. We evaluate five different algorithms: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and ResNet50. To enhance model generalization and reduce overfitting, we employ data augmentation techniques and add dropout layers in the CNN and ResNet50 architectures. Through extensive experimentation, ResNet50 emerges as the best-performing model, achieving an accuracy of approximately 87% on the custom dataset. This work demonstrates the importance of creating domain-specific datasets and using a range of machine learning methods to develop accurate and reliable weather recognition models. Our approach offers a robust solution for outdoor vision systems, with potential applications in autonomous vehicles, surveillance systems, and other environments where accurate weather detection is critical for safety and performance.

articleTitle: Analysis and Suggestions for a 220 kV GIS Trip Fault
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: GIS has significant advantages such as small footprint, strong pollution resistance, easy installation, and flexible operation, and is widely used in urban substations of 72.5kV and above in China. However, due to the lack of experience in the operation of fully enclosed electrical appliances in China, the testing items in the manufacturing and installation process are not complete enough, which may lead to unforeseen hidden dangers in actual use. This article analyzes the causes of an accident caused by the loosening of the fixing bolts between the contact and the contact seat in the busbar interval, during the operation of a 220 kV GIS, resulting in contact finger erosion, shell breakdown, and three phases grounding faults. Simulation methods are used to conduct simulation tests of the fault process. Feasible suggestions are proposed for identifying potential hazards of similar problems.

articleTitle: Object Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Object detection is a kind of image segmentation based on geometric and statistical characteristics of the object. It is not only necessary to identify which classification the object belongs to, but more importantly, to get the specific position of the object in the image. Object detection based on deep learning is the current research hotspot and the future development direction. The YOLOv5s network is the network with the smallest depth and the smallest width of the feature map in the YOLOv5 series, achieving a better balance between speed and accuracy. Based on the analysis of relevant literatures at home and abroad, the structure of YOLOv5s network is studied in this paper. In order to solve the problem that the detection effect is not accurate enough when dealing with complex scenes and high-precision tasks, we improve it by integrating attention mechanism and replacement loss function. The fusion attention mechanism can amplify the important information features and suppress the non-important information features, and the replacement loss function can accelerate the convergence speed and improve the target detection effect. The effectiveness of these two improvements is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Performance Prediction of Web Wrapping Mechanism for Straw Baler Based on Data-Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The importance of intelligent agricultural machinery in the development of modern agriculture cannot be ignored. This article first constructs a system modeling and data analysis framework, collects key operating parameters through sensors, and performs data preprocessing and feature engineering. Subsequently, this article selects the Random Forest (RF) algorithm to construct a preliminary performance prediction model, and evaluates and optimizes the model through methods such as cross validation. In addition, this article also explores the optimization of control strategies, achieving real-time monitoring and adaptive control based on predicted results. The experimental results show that the random forest model exhibits significant advantages in all aspects, with a prediction accuracy of up to 99.8%, a coefficient of determination above 0.95, and significantly better prediction efficiency than other models. In addition, the control strategy optimization experiment further confirmed the practical application value of the data-driven prediction model in improving the performance of the baler winding mechanism.

articleTitle: Improving Bias Detection in NLP Models through Multitask Learning with Cloze and Random Mask Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper applies a multitask learning approach designed to enhance the understanding of textual bias in natural language processing (NLP) models. By combining Cloze and Random Mask (RM) tasks, the study aims to train models that can recognize and bias better within context. The WinoBias dataset is used to verify proposed method, which includes both stereotypical and counter-stereotypical sentences. Applying model under the multitask learning framework allows it to understand diverse contextual scenarios, and then improving its ability to detect biases that might be overlooked. Experimental results evaluated on classification task indicate that this approach significantly improve the model’s performance in bias detection. The study offers a foundation for future work on reducing bias in various text analysis applications. The findings highlight the importance of developing methodologies for detecting bias in automated text processing systems, which ensures more accurate and fair outcomes in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Research on Foreign Language Teaching Effect Prediction Model Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a predictive model for foreign language teaching effectiveness based on deep learning. Firstly, the paper introduces the application of label transfer technology in cross-language environment, and realizes the efficient conversion of labels between different languages through deep learning algorithm, which lays a foundation for the subsequent entity extraction and translation work. Through the combination of shared presentation layer and task-specific layer, the optimization of multiple tasks such as label migration, cross-language entity extraction and self-learning dictionary translation is realized. We use deep neural networks to automatically identify and extract key entity information from multiple languages. At the same time, the self-learning dictionary translation technology is introduced to improve the accuracy and efficiency of translation through continuous learning and optimization. A prediction model for foreign language teaching effect is constructed and its validity and accuracy are verified by many experimental data. The experimental results show that the model can effectively predict the effect of foreign language teaching and provide an important reference for teachers and students.

Author Keywords: prediction of foreign language teaching effect

articleTitle: Research Status of Low-Voltage Temporary Power Supply Access Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the increase in distributed energy resources and the reduction in traditional power plants, the stability of power systems is being challenged, especially in the event of large-scale blackouts. To ensure power system reliability, new emergency concepts and technologies are continuously proposed and developed, making temporary power supply solutions for low-voltage distribution networks a research hotspot in academia and industry. Today, researchers are gradually refining emergency power access technologies for low-voltage distribution networks by comprehensively considering economic and technical feasibility to meet the ever-changing power demands.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Airborne CAN Bus Test Repeater
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This article first introduces the specifications of CAN bus and proposes a new CAN bus testing scheme for applications in airborne environments. This scheme utilizes existing equipment to collect CAN bus data using repeaters and CBM/101 acquisition boards. The following mainly elaborates on the role of relays, and introduces the software and hardware design of relays. The design and implementation of relays are important components of CAN bus testing solutions.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Human Resource Demand Forecasting Model Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study focuses on the application of big data analysis in human resource demand forecasting, aiming to build an effective forecasting model to cope with the demand changes in human resource flow areas. This paper proposes a new model for predicting human resource demand by processing and analyzing human resource related big data based on the K nearest neighbor nonparametric estimation method. In the study, a system simulation verification was carried out by designing an algorithm adapted to the big data environment to test the effectiveness and reliability of the model. During the simulation process, the focus was on the changing laws of human resource flow areas, and the prediction accuracy and adaptability of the model were evaluated through precise data analysis. The research results show that the constructed model can better capture the dynamic changes of human resource demand, especially in the complex background of regional human resource flow, and the prediction effect is excellent. This study not only enriches the application of big data analysis in forecasting models at the theoretical level, but also demonstrates the operability and promotion value of the model in practice.

articleTitle: Study on the Model of Network Health Monitoring System in Care and Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, a network health monitoring system based on augmented reality algorithm is designed to provide more efficient health management services for the elderly. Through the integration of interventional nursing and augmented reality technology, the system realizes real-time monitoring, analysis, and dynamic feedback of user health data. Augmented reality algorithms are used to build interactive interfaces that combine virtual and reality to improve user experience and system operability. The algorithm design of health monitoring system focuses on extracting the key features of health data accurately to improve the accuracy of monitoring and early warning. System simulation verifies the effectiveness and stability of the algorithm. Through the processing and analysis of many health data, the simulation results show that the system has strong adaptability and robustness in diverse scenarios. After adopting the system, the response speed of interventional care decision was increased by about 20%, and the accuracy rate of health abnormality detection was increased by 15%. This study provides an innovative technology path for the field of care and prevention, and lays a foundation for the further development of intelligent health monitoring system.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Change of the US Dollar Price against the Chinese Yuan Based on Neural Network Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Under the background of intensified economic globalization, the exchange rate of the US dollar against the RMB is a major issue in the current economic and trade relations between China and the United States and even in the world's financial field. Consequently, accurately forecasting the movement of the US dollar in relation to the Chinese yuan holds significant practical value. Earlier research primarily employed various quantitative modeling techniques to analyze the time-series characteristics of the USD/CNY exchange rate. However, inconsistencies remain regarding specific issues, necessitating the selection of different models tailored to each problem. As the BP neural network has the advantages of self-learning, self-adaptation, anti-interference, and high generalization. By optimizing the parameters of neural network and improving the data set, an optimization method of the number of hidden layer neurons based on Bayesian algorithm is proposed in this paper. Through the training results and analysis of the neural network, it can be seen that using the improved BP neural network to forecast the exchange rate of RMB against US dollar has higher accuracy and effectiveness and can predict the exchange rate changes of US dollar against RMB more accurately. In real life, it has great reference value for investors to formulate investment strategy and enterprises to carry out risk management.

Author Keywords: number of nodes in hidden layer

articleTitle: Classification of Plant Leaf Diseases Based on EfficientNet
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the in-depth research of deep learning technology, convolutional neural networks have been widely applied in the field of image recognition. However, traditional diagnostic methods for plant leaf diseases often rely on expert experience and time-consuming manual detection, which is inefficient and limited in accuracy. Based on the above background, this paper mainly studies the plant leaf disease classification method based on EfficientNet. Firstly, the EfficientNet algorithm is reviewed, followed by a detailed description of the process of the plant leaf disease classification algorithm and then an analysis of the dataset used. In the simulation analysis, this paper explores the impact of different parameters on the performance of EfficientNet and demonstrates its effectiveness in plant leaf disease classification. The proposed method has efficient and accurate results, significant research significance, and application prospects in the fields of agricultural automation and intelligent diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Student Performance Prediction Based on Deep Learning and Multimodal Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study proposes a student performance prediction framework based on the XGBoost and LSTM integrated model, called the XGLNet Framework. By combining nonlinear features and time series information, it enhances the accuracy of student performance predictions. The research utilizes student learning data, applying the XGLNet Framework for analysis and prediction. Experimental results show that the XGLNet Framework performs excellently across several key performance metrics, including Mean Squared Error (MSE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and the Coefficient of Determination (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). Compared to standalone XGBoost and LSTM models, the XGLNet Framework significantly reduces prediction errors and improves model fit. It effectively captures both nonlinear changes and temporal trends in student performance. Future research can further optimize the framework to enhance its applicability and robustness in broader educational scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Car Interface Interaction Optimization Algorithm Based on User Experience Human Factors Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study proposes an intelligent car interface interaction optimization algorithm based on user experience human factors engineering. The algorithm combines the basic principles of human factors engineering, designs the interface interaction of intelligent cars, and adopts deep reinforcement learning (DRL) technology to adapt to diverse user needs and complex driving scenarios. By collecting and analyzing the interactive behaviors of users in different situations, the algorithm can adaptively adjust the interface layout, information presentation and interaction mode to improve the overall user experience. Through simulation verification, the experimental results show that the optimization algorithm can effectively improve the user's operating experience in a variety of driving scenarios, significantly reducing the user's cognitive load, and improving the interaction efficiency. Simulation data analysis shows that the interface response time after optimization is reduced by an average of 23.5%, and user satisfaction is increased by 15.8%. The results of this study provide new ideas for the design and optimization of intelligent car interface interaction, and lay the foundation for the optimization of human-computer interaction in future intelligent driving systems.

articleTitle: Research on New Business Data Analysis and Visualization Technology Assisted by Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study introduces a novel approach to business data analysis and visualization, leveraging artificial intelligence techniques, particularly the t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE) algorithm for dimensionality reduction and the graphical representation of high-dimensional datasets. The proposed system integrates a variety of algorithmic frameworks, including principal component analysis (PCA) and various clustering algorithms, aiming to enhance both the efficiency and precision of business data interpretation. Through extensive simulation tests conducted on large-scale business data sets, the t-SNE algorithm effectively transforms intricate high-dimensional information into a two-dimensional format, providing a clear visualization of data clusters and inherent patterns. The experimental outcomes reveal that the visualization platform utilizing t-SNE significantly enhances the depth of data interpretation, particularly when handling multidimensional data, demonstrating superior accuracy and resilience. Compared to conventional visualization methods, this system exhibits approximately a 15% increase in accuracy during large-scale business data processing, offering substantial support for corporate decision-making processes. This research presents innovative intelligent tools for business data analysis, further advancing the data-driven decision-making framework in the corporate domain.

articleTitle: Analysis of Geometric Parameters Error and Simulation of Six-Degree-of-Freedom Industrial Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the application of industrial robots, precision has always been a key factor restricting the improvement of their performance. In this paper, the Staubli TX60 serial robot is taken as the research object to study the geometric parameter error analysis of industrial robot precision performance improvement system. The static pose error model of the robot is constructed by full differential of the error parameters of Staubli TX60, and the influence of geometric parameters on the static pose error of the robot is studied. Starting from the influence of joint errors on the robot, the degree of influence of each joint on the error is analyzed one by one, and the end effector position and attitude are obtained through simulation analysis of the robot's end effector. The results show that the second joint of the robot has the greatest influence on the end effector's pose, and the accuracy of the end effector pose error model of the industrial robot is analyzed based on the second joint. This provides reference for the improvement of the precision of the industrial robot.

articleTitle: Design of Library Automatic Navigation Intelligent Vehicle System Based on ROS
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This article introduces a library automatic navigation intelligent vehicle system based on ROS. The system aims to improve the management efficiency of the library and optimize the service experience for readers. The smart car uses LiDAR for environmental scanning and map construction, and achieves autonomous path planning and navigation through SLAM technology. The smart car is equipped with a robotic arm and ca7era, which can recognize and grab books, and automatically navigate to the user's location. The system uses Nvidia JETSON Orin Nano as the upper computer and STM32F407 as the lower computer, and utilizes ROS functional packages such as Gmapping and Move_base for map building, positioning, and path planning. In addition, the system also provides remote control and voice control interfaces, and incorporates safety measures to ensure the safety and reliability of the smart car during navigation.

articleTitle: Research on Wind Power Prediction Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Wind power prediction is not only vital for the secure and stable operation of power grids but also significantly supports the economic benefits, environmental protection, and policy-making of wind farms. Wind power prediction currently confronts challenges such as substantial data demands, stringent data quality requirements, limited interpretability of prediction models, and a high degree of model overfitting. This paper introduces a deep learning time-series prediction model based on stacking. By comparing seven individual deep learning temporal prediction models, this approach demonstrates higher prediction accuracy than conventional deep learning temporal models.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Multimodal Knowledge Graph for Power Grid Infrastructure Construction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper systematically studies and designs a multimodal knowledge graph system suitable for power grid infrastructure construction, aiming to optimize information integration and decision support in the construction process. The system obtains real-time information of the construction site through high-precision images and sensor data, and uses the named entity recognition (NER) algorithm enhanced by the attention mechanism to accurately extract key entities and relationships related to construction from multi-source data such as images, texts, and sensors. In the system simulation stage, this paper verifies it through a large amount of real data, focusing on evaluating the performance of the NER algorithm and the effectiveness of the attention mechanism. The results show that compared with the traditional algorithm, the NER algorithm using the attention mechanism has a significant improvement in recognition accuracy, especially when processing complex scene data, its accuracy has increased by more than 15%. In addition, the multimodal knowledge graph performs well in showing the correlation between different modal data, providing a more intuitive and operational decision support tool for construction site managers.

articleTitle: A Distributed Storage and Management Method for Hypertext Files and Metadata Based on Consortium Chain
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This article provides a distributed storage and management method for hypertext files and metadata based on consortium chains. By receiving storage requests from storage users, including files to be stored, request information, and the number of storage copies, the files to be stored are fragmented into N shard sets. For each shard set, the encrypted data set and hash array corresponding to the shard set are obtained by encrypting the shards and calculating the hash of the encrypted shards. The root hash is returned to the storage user, and the encrypted data set and hash array are sent to the distributed storage system. At the same time, based on the request information and the root hash corresponding to all shard sets, we generate transaction metadata, generate transaction transactions by calling smart contracts or transactions, and broadcast them to the blockchain network. This method solves the problems of low query efficiency, difficulty in supporting fuzzy search, and complex data storage management logic in distributed storage systems.

articleTitle: Research on Water Environment Monitoring System Based on STM32 Multi Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This article provides an in-depth analysis of traditional water environment monitoring technologies, combined with the practical needs of water quality monitoring, and considering the unique advantages of wireless sensing technology, designs and constructs a water environment monitoring system based on STM32 microcontroller. By using STM32 microcontroller as the core processing unit, multiple sensors are integrated to monitor water quality parameters in real-time, such as pH value, dissolved oxygen, turbidity, etc. The sensor interface circuit and data acquisition algorithm are optimized to achieve high-precision and low-noise data acquisition. This provides an efficient and intelligent solution for water environment monitoring in China, as well as new ideas and methods for the development of STM32 embedded systems.

articleTitle: A Meteorological Risk Identification and Early Warning Model for Power System Based on Multi-Source Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study utilizes multi-source data fusion technology and advanced Corrformer models to improve the prediction accuracy and response efficiency of the power system to extreme meteorological conditions. At the beginning of the study, the key to meteorological forecasting was discussed in detail, especially in the context of global climate change, the impact and challenges of frequent extreme weather on power infrastructure. In the experimental phase, we recorded the performance indicators of the Corrformer model under both conventional and extreme meteorological conditions, and found that its average response time under standard meteorological conditions was only 200 milliseconds, slightly longer under extreme conditions, at 250 milliseconds. The overall prediction accuracy remained at 85%. These data validate the significant advantages of the Corrformer model in improving prediction speed and accuracy compared to traditional prediction tools, greatly enhancing the stability and safety of the power system in responding to extreme weather events.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network-Based Prediction of B-Cell Epitopes for SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2: Enhancing Vaccine Design through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The accurate prediction of B-cell epitopes is critical for guiding vaccine development against infectious diseases, including SARS and COVID-19. This study explores the use of a deep neural network (DNN) model to predict B-cell epitopes for SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2, leveraging a dataset that incorporates essential protein and peptide features. Traditional sequence-based methods often struggle with large, complex datasets, but deep learning offers promising improvements in predictive accuracy. Our model employs regularization techniques, such as dropout and early stopping, to enhance generalization, while also analyzing key features, including isoelectric point and aromaticity, which influence epitope recognition. Results indicate an overall accuracy of 82% in predicting COVID-19 negative and positive cases, with room for improvement in detecting positive samples. This research demonstrates the applicability of deep learning in epitope mapping, suggesting that such approaches can enhance the speed and precision of vaccine design for emerging pathogens. Future work could incorporate structural data and diverse viral strains to further refine prediction capabilities.

articleTitle: Research on exchange rate risk prediction model based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Against the backdrop of the continuous appreciation of the renminbi, foreign exchange risk management is crucial. Therefore, it is necessary to adopt scientific and reasonable methods to predict and optimize the exchange rate risk prediction model. According to the specific characteristics of the exchange rate model, this paper selects the analysis method of fusing time-frequency signal analysis and neural network model, and preliminarily analyzes and preprocesses the price level of the RMB exchange rate. By using the ensemble empirical mode decomposition method, the signals are effectively screened and reconstructed, and then the neural network is used to predict the price level of the RMB exchange rate. The model accurately captures the trend of fluctuations, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed prediction method. This is of far-reaching practical significance for the foreign exchange management department to avoid market risks and cope with various impacts brought about by interest rate and exchange rate fluctuations.

articleTitle: Optimal dispatching of rural microgrids based on uncertain output power of wind and photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Addressing the output power of wind and photovoltaic power generation has become increasingly important with the dramatic increase in the amount of power generated from wind and photovoltaics. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a model which combines uncertainty of wind and photovoltaics with heating demand. It is used mixed linear integer programming for simulation optimization. At the same time, considering the uncertainty of the output power of wind power and photovoltaic power generation, the rural microgrids are optimized for dispatching to improve the ability of rural microgrids and consume wind power and photovoltaic power generation, so as to improve his practicality. Based on a conventional rural microgrid, the simulation example is modified to obtain the improved method of rural microgrid. In this study, the conventional rural microgrid and the modified rural microgrid are used as examples for optimal dispatching, so as to verify the correctness of the model.

articleTitle: Research on cold chain path optimisation model using genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper investigates the cold chain logistics distribution path optimization problem. Based on the generalized transportation cost (including fixed cost, transportation cost and penalty cost), a path optimization model containing time window constraints is developed. By applying genetic algorithm, coding solution is carried out. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by combining with practical cases. The results show that Genetic algorithms have excellent performance, the distribution path optimized by the algorithm can avoid the penalty cost of the product due to the failure of timely delivery, and also optimize the path to achieve the lowest total cost of distribution.

articleTitle: Discourse Element Identification Integrated with Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: To address the challenge of insufficient contextual dependency understanding in discourse element recognition, we propose a recognition model that incorporates an attention mechanism. This model analyzes sentence structure and positional information, using Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Units (BiGRU) and an attention mechanism to enhance the understanding of contextual information, thereby capturing the relationships among sentence components more accurately and improving classification accuracy. Additionally, we introduce Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for capturing inter-sentence dependencies. Experimental results show that our model outperforms existing baseline models across multiple datasets, confirming the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on county traffic optimization model based on spatio-temporal big data analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This investigation endeavors to address the challenging issue of forecasting and enhancing traffic flow through the development of a county-level traffic optimization framework grounded in spatio-temporal big data analytics. Toward this objective, the present work introduces a composite approach integrating a convolutional long short-term memory network with a particle swarm optimization technique. Initially, ConvLSTM is employed to discern the intricate patterns within spatio-temporal traffic datasets, thereby precisely grasping the fluctuations and interdependencies of traffic volumes over space and time. Building upon these insights, the PSO method refines the parameters governing traffic signal operations and route planning to ascertain the attainment of an optimal solution. This framework not only enhances the precision of traffic flow projections but also facilitates the holistic improvement of traffic networks. Consequently, it furnishes a novel and viable strategy for managing county traffic, aiding in the alleviation of congestion and boosting traffic fluidity.

articleTitle: Parking Space Path Planning Frameworks Based on Bilevel Programming Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The bilevel programming planning can perform hierarchical optimization for two objectives with obvious priorities, which is well suited for application in pathfinding planning scenarios. In this paper, we propose a path planning framework for parking lot reservation pathfinding scenarios. The framework first constructs a real-time allocation model for dynamic parking space reservation based on factual demand data by developing a dynamic parking lot reservation system. Then, it is oriented to low carbon and optimal walking distance and solved using Floyd's algorithm. After that, based on the dynamic reservation real-time allocation model and the bilevel programming planning, the model is simulated and calculated with real cases, which shows that compared with the traditional model, the framework can reduce the carbon emission by about 6.9%-9.2%, and verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the planning framework.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Big Data and Artificial Intelligence Technologies in Computer Network Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the current construction of computer network systems, big data technology and artificial intelligence technology are playing an active role, with significant implications for enhancing system functions and ensuring data security. Starting from the security of computer network systems, this paper separately elaborates on the application solutions of big data technology and artificial intelligence in enhancing network security. A flow-sensing and analysis system for network security based on big data technology has been established, while a topology network attack detection software has been developed through artificial intelligence. The final test data of the two software systems show that these systems have strong operability and powerful functions, and are playing a positive role in enhancing the security of computer network systems, which are worth promoting.

articleTitle: Improved Photovoltaic Maximum Power Point Tracking Algorithm Integrating Intelligent Fuzzy Control with the Variable-Step-Size Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: To address the inadequate tracking performance of the traditional perturb-and-observe (P&O) method, commonly employed for the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) of photovoltaic (PV) systems, particularly under rapidly changing environmental conditions, this paper proposes an improved MPPT algorithm that combines fuzzy control logic with the variable-step-size method. Here, the fuzzy controller first addresses the uncertainties associated with light-intensity and temperature variations, then predicts the MPP position, and dynamically adjusts the perturbation step size to realize rapid and precise tracking of the MPP. Simulation results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed algorithm over the traditional P&O method and the variable-step-size algorithm in terms of its tracking speed and stability. In particular, the proposed algorithm quickly responds to rapid environmental changes, mitigates power loss, and improves the overall efficiency of the PV system.

articleTitle: A study on stock market forecasting based on time series with integrated multi-feature LSTM modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper constructs an effective stock prediction model, which can help investors better understand the market trend and accurately grasp the fluctuation pattern of stock prices, thus guiding them to formulate reasonable investment strategies. Taking Hengrui Medicine as the research object, we collected the stock data, established the feature engineering, set up the index evaluation system for the stock features, and constructed the six features of turnover, average price, relative increase, turnover change volume, increase/decrease amplitude, and amplitude from the aspects of enterprise value, enterprise development potential, and capital stability, respectively. In addition, principal component analysis is used to extract effective information and remove redundant information from the constructed features and original features. The decomposition model, exponential smoothing model, ARIMA and SARIMA are applied to the stock price prediction task of Hengrui Medicine. For the decomposition model, the STL and SEATS decomposition methods are used to decompose the closing rate into seasonal terms, trend-period terms, and residual terms. After that, we tried to integrate machine learning models, such as XGBoost, Adaboost and other Boosting models, and Random Forest and other Bagging models, and formed the meta-model into a Stacking model to evaluate the effect of different methods on stock feature extraction. Finally, we use LSTM model in deep learning field and apply its single-feature and multi-feature input dimensions respectively, and combine the previous models to form an integrated machine learning-multi-feature LSTM stock prediction model, and horizontally compare the traditional and modern methods, and get the conclusion that it has a good fitting effect.

articleTitle: High dimensional multi-attribute big data association mining method based on semantic feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: High dimensional multi-attribute big data mining is a key technology for processing natural language and database access. A high-dimensional multi-attribute big data association mining based on semantic feature fusion is proposed. Data collection and cleaning techniques are used to achieve bias learning in the natural language processing process. Semantic feature fusion methods are used to remove redundant data, fill in gaps, and smooth data. A residual feature decomposition model for high-dimensional multi data big data is constructed. Multiple semantic segmentation methods are used to extract multi-source semantic feature quantities such as interests and emotions from big data. Time sequence analysis and correlation analysis methods are used to filter and clean redundant data in the big data mining process. Standardized semantic feature fusion methods are combined to cluster the high-dimensional multi data big data mined. And segmentation, we realize spatiotemporal and causal correlations for high-dimensional, multi data, and big data. The simulation test results show that this method can effectively achieve spatiotemporal correlation and causal correlation in big data association mining, realize semantic sentiment analysis of big data, accurately evaluate the diversity of information dissemination across communities, and provide an intuitive choice for classification problems with similar data features.

Author Keywords: High dimensional and multi-attribute big data

articleTitle: LDPC Decoding Based on Hybrid Stochastic Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Compared with traditional computing methods, stochastic computing (SC) is simpler in circuit implementation. The Belief Propagation (BP) or Min-Sum (MS) algorithms used in traditional Low Density Parity Check (LDPC) decoding require a large amount of circuits for the calculation of check nodes (CNs). In this paper, decoding is completed on a decoding structure that combines the advantages of the Offset Min-Sum (OMS) algorithm and SC. CN information is calculated in the probability domain, and variable node (VN) information is calculated in the Log Likelihood Ratio (LLR) domain. It is proposed to use the gold sequence combined with a synchronizer to generate a positively correlated sequence, and combine the Noise-Dependent Scaling (NDS) algorithm to obtain a positively correlated random number generator to complete the conversion from LLR to a positively correlated bit stream. The positively correlated bit stream is input into an AND gate to find the minimum value of the input bit streams. Simulation results show that the bit error rate curve of the proposed method is close to the OMS algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on Energy Meter Status Assessment Using Support Vector Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The improved accuracy of energy meter status assessment helps the grid to set accurate electricity prices. A method of clustering and then evaluating the running state of electric meters is proposed. First, the indicators that affect the running state of the meter are extracted. Then, k-means algorithm is used to cluster electricity meters. Then, particle swarm optimization support vector regression algorithm is used to build the prediction model of electric meter. Simulation and comparative analysis show that the proposed method has higher prediction accuracy than the traditional BP algorithm.

articleTitle: Comparison of EfficientNet and VGGNet Using RGB Photos for Human Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the field of computer vision, human action recognition, is a key technology, underpinning numerous application scenarios such as video surveillance, human-computer interaction, sports analysis, and more. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based models have demonstrated impressive performance in human action detection difficulties due to the swift advancement of deep learning techniques. The subject matter focuses on the research of human action identification using two advanced CNN models, VGGNet and EfficientNet, on RGB image datasets. It also compares the differences in feature extraction and classification capabilities between the VGGNet and EfficientNet models. This paper selects an RGB image dataset containing information on 15 categories of human actions as the experimental basis, providing strong support for model training. During the evaluation phase, accuracy is adopted as the metric, and each model's capabilities undergo evaluation. The results indicate that the EfficientNet model exhibits higher accuracy and better generalization capabilities in human action recognition tasks, primarily due to its efficient network structure and optimized model design. The categorization of various postures aids in the advancement of technology for recognizing human behavior and helps to highlight the diversity and complexity of human behavior.

articleTitle: Dynamic Visual Design and Implementation Technology Based on Visual Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This research develops and evaluates an innovative dynamic visual design system that integrates real-time rendering technology, AI-assisted features, and an intuitive user interface. Through comprehensive performance testing, user experience evaluation, and competitive analysis, the system demonstrates significant advantages in processing speed, resource utilization efficiency, and user-friendliness. Notably, it has made groundbreaking progress in high-definition video processing, AI-assisted creation, and optimization of the learning curve. The results confirm the system's substantial value in enhancing design efficiency, lowering the usage threshold, and boosting creative expressiveness, providing robust support for technological innovation in the dynamic visual design field. Furthermore, the system's scalability and adaptability to emerging technologies position it as a future-proof solution for the evolving demands of the creative industry. The implications of this research extend beyond immediate applications, potentially revolutionizing workflows in adjacent fields such as virtual reality content creation and interactive media design. Future work will focus on continuous refinement of the system, incorporating user feedback and emerging technologies to further enhance its capabilities and maintain its relevance in the rapidly evolving landscape of digital design.

articleTitle: Submersible Position Prediction and Search Model Based on Nonlinear Physical Prediction and NSGA-II Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Nonlinear physical prediction models and the NSGA-II algorithm also have great application scenarios in location prediction search. In this paper, we take the scenario of position prediction and search after the failure of a submersible as an example. Firstly, the ferrite physical prediction modeling is carried out for the three scenarios of no mechanical failure after loss of connection, with mechanical failure and sinking towards the seabed, and at the buoyancy neutral point. Afterwards, a dual-objective optimization of search probability and search time is implemented using the NSGA-II algorithm, aiming to maximize the search probability and minimize the search time. Finally, the path optimization strategies of the three submersibles when searching in conjunction with each other are verified by simulating the actual scenarios, which provides an important theoretical basis and practical guidance for submersible troubleshooting.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Assessment and Early Warning Research for Inundation Risk of Electric Power Facilities
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: To solve the problem of power supply failure caused by rainstorm inundation, a dynamic assessment and early warning method for inundation risk of electric power facilities based on two-dimensional hydrodynamic model is proposed in this paper. The Chicago rainfall model and two-dimensional hydrodynamic model are used to model the rainstorm inundation of power facility nodes. The weighted comprehensive evaluation method is used to calculate the risk probability of the failure event of the flooded facilities. A short-term load prediction model combining variational mode decomposition (VMD) and long short-term memory (LSTM) is proposed to forecast the short-term load of the grid nodes during the rainstorm. A classification method of risk and warning levels is proposed to mark nodes, in order to provide scientific decision-making basis for the managers of electric power facilities. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by taking a regional power grid as an example. The application process of the proposed method is further illustrated by taking the power grid of a certain region as an example. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are proved.

articleTitle: Research on the Synchronization Control Algorithm of Memristor Chaotic System under Single-Input Feedback Control
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper studies the synchronization control algorithm of memristor chaotic system under single-input feedback control. This paper proposes a synchronization algorithm based on single-input feedback control. The algorithm realizes the synchronization control of memristor chaotic system based on reducing control input. Then, a single-input feedback controller is designed based on the mathematical model of memristor chaotic system to ensure the stability of synchronization. Then, the convergence of the control algorithm is verified by Lyapunov stability theory. This paper also constructs a simulation model of the system in MATLAB environment and performs numerical simulation on the proposed synchronization control algorithm. The simulation results show that the system synchronization error converges to zero under the set parameter conditions, indicating the effectiveness and accuracy of the algorithm. In addition, the control accuracy is further quantified by comparing different feedback control gain parameters. The results show that the adjustment of feedback gain can significantly improve the response speed and accuracy of system synchronization. The synchronization control algorithm of memristor chaotic system based on single-input feedback control proposed in this paper has been effectively verified both theoretically and numerically, and has good application potential.

articleTitle: Design of Yaw Stability for Distributed Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Note on the stability and safety issues in the development of electric vehicles. Now, the ability of distributed drive vehicles to maintain lateral stability in the driving process is analyzed. The Carsim is used to establish the vehicle system model, simply reason the yaw speed and the center Angle of the vehicle, and design the yaw torque control strategy. The vehicle dynamic stability control system is established through the joint simulation platform and the state observer, and the state and working environment of the vehicle in multiple environments are corrected, so as to improve the stability of the vehicle.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Crossing Trajectory Prediction Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Predicting pedestrian trajectories plays an important role in improving the safety of driverless driving, while pedestrians have extremely high uncertainty. It is difficult to correctly predict trajectories using traditional physics prediction, and deep learning neural networks have more advantages. In order to analyze and improve the prediction of pedestrian crossing trajectory based on deep learning, this paper constructs LSTM network model, TCN network model and Transformer network model, and applies them to a virtual 3D dataset for trajectory prediction, and compares and analyzes the training performance and prediction performance of the three models. Additionally, the Transformer network is enhanced with an autoregressive mechanism, a positional embedding mechanism, and optimized training strategies, resulting in the Transformer model achieving the best performance for pedestrian trajectory prediction on this dataset. This paper summarizes the characteristics of different neural network models in pedestrian trajectory prediction and outlines future research directions.

articleTitle: Research on User Experience Adaptive Algorithm in Intelligent Connected Vehicle Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study focuses on the application of user interface adaptive algorithm in multimodal interaction in intelligent connected vehicles. With the rapid development of intelligent vehicle networking technology, the user interface needs to dynamically adapt to different user needs and environmental changes in complex interaction scenarios. This paper proposes a user interface adaptive model that combines Markov chain algorithm and Double Deep Q Network (DDQN) algorithm to achieve intelligent decision-making and adaptive optimization in multimodal interaction. The model analyzes the user's historical interaction behavior, uses Markov chain to predict the user's operation sequence, and optimizes the interaction mode in different scenarios through DDQN algorithm, and finally realizes the adaptive adjustment of the user interface. Simulation results show that the adaptive algorithm can effectively improve the response speed and accuracy of the user interface in complex environments, while greatly reducing the complexity of user operations. Accurate data analysis further proves that the model shows high flexibility and robustness in multimodal interaction, providing new ideas and technical support for the optimization of user experience of intelligent connected vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on the algorithm for identifying the correlation between power outage plans based on knowledge graph
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the complex process of arranging power outage plans in the power grid, the correlation between each outage plan will be accurately defined based on rich historical arrangement experience and professional knowledge, in order to achieve preliminary optimization and processing of outage plan data. Due to the heavy workload of power grid outage planning, traditional manual scheduling methods are not only inefficient, but also susceptible to subjective interference, affecting the accuracy and reliability of scheduling. To this end, the electric power knowledge graph algorithm is introduced to accurately distinguish the correlation between power outage plans through intelligent means. Firstly, a comprehensive analysis was conducted on the application characteristics of knowledge graph algorithms in the field of power dispatch. On this basis, the discrimination rules between "simultaneous power outage" and "non simultaneous power outage" plans in the power grid outage plan were thoroughly sorted out, and the topology structure of the power grid and the outage plan were ingeniously separated into entities, successfully constructing a knowledge graph based outage plan correlation discrimination algorithm. The verification results show that the knowledge graph based discrimination algorithm proposed in this paper can efficiently and accurately identify the complex correlation relationships between different power outage plans. In practical applications, it significantly reduces the risk of repeated power outages and power outage plan conflicts, effectively improving the intelligence level and execution efficiency of power grid power outage plan scheduling, and has high promotion and application value.

articleTitle: Application of VR Driving Game in Visual Research of Unmanned Car
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: At present, most of the test of unmanned vehicles at home and abroad uses the construction of actual test sites to test the unmanned vehicles. However, the road conditions required for unmanned vehicle tests are relatively high, requiring a large amount of capital and labor. The material resources are very huge, and there are some natural environmental factors beyond human control. In view of the limitations of the above tests, it is of great significance to construct a safe, effective, economical and stable unmanned vehicle test environment. This article mainly studies the application of VR driving games in the visual research of driverless cars. The test environment of this paper includes virtual reality scene module, micro traffic simulation module, virtual reality interaction module, network communication module, and unmanned vehicle module. The unmanned vehicle on the test bench makes corresponding behavior decisions based on the received virtual scene data, and transmits these behavior decision data to the virtual unmanned vehicle in the virtual scene through network communication. The virtual unmanned vehicle operates in a virtual scene after obtaining data such as vehicle speed, heading angle, and brakes. This operating state is used to express the state of the real unmanned vehicle, thereby verifying the intelligence of the real unmanned vehicle. The experiments in this paper show that the network model has a high average accuracy rate under the same test time, and the detection speed can reach 13 frames per second. It can be seen that the overall performance of YOLOv3 is better. The test results show that YOLOv3 algorithm has better accuracy and real-time performance on seven common traffic sign detections.

articleTitle: Research on User Experience Engineering Evaluation Algorithm for Human-Computer Interaction Interface of Intelligent Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a user experience engineering evaluation algorithm for human-computer interaction interface of intelligent vehicles based on fuzzy logic algorithm, aiming to evaluate and optimize through effective user feedback data. The study designed a user experience evaluation model for human-computer interaction of intelligent vehicles, considering key factors such as visual comfort, interactive response speed, and functional convenience. Fuzzy logic algorithm is used to deal with uncertainty and fuzziness problems, and a more accurate user experience evaluation system is constructed. The system algorithm design combines multi-dimensional data input to simulate the model to ensure the accuracy and stability of the algorithm. The simulation results show that the algorithm has significant advantages in evaluation accuracy, user satisfaction prediction, etc., and has good practical application potential. Data analysis shows that the system can provide users with a more optimized interactive experience in complex driving environments and improve the overall user satisfaction of intelligent vehicles. Through precise data analysis of algorithm simulation, its effectiveness in improving the quality of human-computer interaction and optimizing user experience is verified.

articleTitle: Research on International Trade Settlement and Tracking System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The research on international trade settlement and tracking system based on blockchain technology aims to solve the problems of low efficiency, lack of transparency and data security in the traditional cross-border trade settlement process. By introducing distributed ledger technology, the system can realize real-time tracking of all links of cross-border trade, ensure the immutability of data, and thus improving data transparency and traceability. The application of zero-knowledge proof technology in this system further guarantees the privacy of transaction data, that is, the legality and authenticity of the transaction can be verified without revealing specific sensitive information. This system can not only significantly reduce the trust cost of relying on intermediaries, but also improve settlement efficiency through automated processes. Through simulation analysis, the test results show that the system shows high stability and reliability when processing high-concurrency transactions, especially in protecting data privacy, reducing trust costs and improving settlement efficiency. The precise data analysis of the simulation results further verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the system in the actual international trade environment, laying a solid foundation for future promotion and application.

Author Keywords: international trade settlement and tracking system

articleTitle: Research on Typhoon Classification and Path Prediction Based on Multi-model Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Typhoons are prone to disasters such as gales, heavy rains and storm surges. Studies have shown that the formation of typhoons is linked to the meteorological conditions of tropical oceans, and the trajectories of typhoon movements are highly complex and nonlinear. The aim of this paper is to establish a fusion model based on multi-model classification and evaluation prediction, to analyze the relationship between the characteristic parameters of typhoons and factors such as temperature, air pressure, monsoon, etc., and to predict the path of typhoons and their impacts after landfall. In this paper, Spearman correlation is first used to analyze the relationship between the characteristic parameters of typhoons and factors such as temperature, pressure and monsoon. Then, the typhoons are clustered using K-means. Based on the classification results, a random forest algorithm is used to classify the typhoon indicators, and the data are brought in for training and typhoon path mapping. Subsequently, taking ‘Bebija’ as an example, this paper chooses the LSTM model to predict its route, and uses the dynamic time regularization algorithm to compare with the actual travel route.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Path Optimization of Warehousing Management System Based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This research applies the simulated annealing algorithm within a logistics warehousing system to address the inherent complexity and unpredictability of optimizing distribution routes. By devising an appropriate algorithmic framework and incorporating the specific logistics demands alongside the warehousing layout, this paper establishes a model for optimizing distribution paths. The model is then validated through the application of computer-based simulation techniques. Throughout the simulation, the system dynamically adjusts the distribution routes according to varying logistics scenarios and delivery requirements, ultimately producing optimized results across different conditions. The simulation outcomes demonstrate that the simulated annealing algorithm performs efficiently in resolving distribution route optimization challenges, yielding substantial improvements in both route distance and delivery times. The results from the data analysis indicate that the path optimized using the simulated annealing algorithm outperforms conventional methods across several critical metrics, including overall distance traveled and time required. These findings confirm the practical viability and enhanced effectiveness of the algorithm when applied to real-world scenarios, demonstrating its superior performance compared to traditional approaches. The algorithm's ability to achieve better optimization in key performance indicators further substantiates its applicability and success in distribution path optimization tasks.

articleTitle: Research on test data analysis and processing technology based on regression analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the process of equipment test, a large amount of data supporting the evaluation of test results will be generated, but limited by the means of data collection, after the completion of data collection, a series of data processing means need to be adopted to meet the requirements of the evaluation of results before supporting the evaluation of results. As a mathematical method used to find the relationship between dependent variables and independent variables, regression analysis is very suitable for equipment test data processing. This paper takes test data analysis and processing as the research object, adopts regression analysis method, and verifies the feasibility and availability of the test data analysis and processing technology of regression analysis through theoretical analysis and practical application.

articleTitle: Research and Design of eVTOL Garage Scheduling and Management Systems for Urban Air Mobility
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As global urbanization accelerates, traffic congestion has emerged as a crucial issue affecting the sustainable development of cities. Urban Air Mobility (UAM) has been introduced as an effective solution to alleviate ground traffic congestion. Electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL) vehicles, known for their speed, flexibility, and sustainability, have garnered significant attention. However, the widespread implementation of eVTOLs faces technical challenges in efficient and safe scheduling and management. This paper investigates and designs an intelligent eVTOL garage scheduling and management system tailored for urban air traffic. Through system requirement analysis, a modular system architecture was proposed, and an intelligent scheduling algorithm was developed using mathematical modeling and ant colony optimization, enhancing the scheduling process. The results demonstrate that the established mathematical model accurately describes the complex constraints and objectives of eVTOL scheduling, and the proposed ant colony algorithm effectively resolves scheduling issues, improving task allocation and resource utilization efficiency. The system design meets the real-time data processing, high concurrency, and scalability requirements of urban eVTOL operations. This study provides a scientific solution for designing and managing eVTOL garage systems in urban air traffic, enhancing the accessibility and reliability of urban air transportation.

articleTitle: Multidimensional Meteorological Data Analysis of Power System and Construction of Multi Temporal and Spatial Scale Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this article, we introduce a novel Convolutional Neural Network Long Short Term Memory Network (CNN-LSTM) model aimed at predicting multidimensional meteorological data that affects the power system. Given the continuous growth of global climate change and energy demand, the power system is often affected by extreme weather events, which pose serious challenges to power supply. Therefore, developing a model that can accurately predict changes in power load is extremely important for the management and scheduling of the power system. Our experimental results show that the average absolute error of the CNN-LSTM model in temperature prediction is about 2°C, humidity is 3%, and wind speed is 1.5 m/s. The above data results indicate that its effectiveness and reliability in processing complex meteorological data are of great significance for meteorological risk management in power systems.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Power Data Security and Compliance Management Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: There are numerous data management and security compliance challenges that exist in the power industry such as issues related to data security, compliance and efficient data management. The goal of this research is to design and implement a power data security and compliance management framework. At the beginning of the research, the analysis and research of power data management, access control requirements, data security requirements, and compliance standards were conducted. After the design of the power data security and compliance management framework architecture and the functional modules, it was possible to complete the design. In the final design, four modules were presented: data encryption, access control, identity authentication, and auditing. By further adopting advanced techniques and algorithms such as parallel processing, high-speed network transmission, and data structure optimization, they improved system efficiency and throughput. By reflecting on data management, access control, configuration difficulty, and processing time, it was found that both tagging time and system throughput were shortened, and that there was no competition between data management tasks and concurrent authentication tasks, or between data processing tasks and data structure optimization.

articleTitle: Optimization of Service Performance for Green Electricity Trading Platform Based on Distributed Authentication
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Traditional green electricity trading platforms typically use centralized authentication models to ensure data security. But with the explosive growth of transaction data, centralized authentication models face service capacity bottlenecks. In order to achieve this goal, we use blockchain technology to implement distributed identity verification, and propose a distributed system communication network optimization method to address the communication delay problem in massive data trading scenarios. We optimize the network structure and significantly improve the service performance of the green power trading platform.

articleTitle: A Personalized Education Recommendation Algorithm Based on Student Learning Behavior and Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of online education, accurately capturing students’ learning behaviors and providing personalized learning recommendations has become a key issue in the field of educational technology. To address this challenge, this study proposes a Behavior-Guided Graph Learning Network (BGGLN) model, which integrates Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and Graph Neural Networks (GNN). The model utilizes LSTM to capture the temporal features of students’ learning behaviors, while GNN models the complex relationships between students and learning resources, enabling more precise personalized recommendations. This study evaluates the model using a multimodal dataset that includes student behavior data and a learning resource graph. Experimental results show that the BGGLN model outperforms traditional LSTM and GNN models in various metrics such as accuracy, F1 score, and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> , achieving an accuracy of 93%, and effectively reducing errors in the recommendation system. Compared to other models, the BGGLN model demonstrates stronger learning capability and generalization performance, proving its practical application value in complex learning scenarios.

articleTitle: Improved Sine Cosine Algorithm for Estimating Parameters of Sine Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: When the sampling time is limited, it becomes challenging to determine the parameters of overlapping sinusoidal signals with similar frequencies using traditional Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithms. In this paper, we propose a step-by-step solution method. Firstly, we employ the modified covariance method to estimate the frequencies of the signals. Next, we introduce the concept of Simulated Annealing (SA) into the Sine Cosine Algorithm (SCA). Consequently, we propose a fusion algorithm, called the Simulated Annealing Sine Cosine Algorithm (SASCA), to determine parameters such as amplitude and initial phase.
