Simulation results demonstrate that the step-by-step solution method proposed in this paper effectively estimates each parameter of the sinusoidal signal while exhibiting notable noise immunity. Furthermore, SASCA performs better than SCA.

articleTitle: Research on the Analysis and Prediction Model of Health Monitoring Data Based on the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This research centers on the development of an advanced model for analyzing and forecasting elderly health monitoring data, leveraging the Internet of Things (IoT) technology. A comprehensive health monitoring system specifically designed for the elderly is established, enabling the real-time acquisition and transmission of daily health metrics through the integration of IoT technologies. During the data analysis phase, an association rule mining algorithm is utilized to identify hidden patterns and correlations within the elderly health data, thereby facilitating the prediction of health outcomes. A subsequent health prediction model is formulated, incorporating data mining and machine learning methodologies, with its effectiveness and reliability rigorously assessed through simulation experiments. The outcomes of these simulations demonstrate a significant enhancement in both the precision and efficiency of the prediction model. This progress provides a solid scientific basis for the health management of the elderly population. Further model simulations confirmed the accuracy and practicality of the developed prediction model, underscoring its extensive potential for application in elderly health management.

articleTitle: Research on the coal-fired cogeneration unit's performance evaluation technique
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In a large energy unit that burns coal, the regenerative stages change greatly affects the economic efficiency of the unit. For researching such influential degree in all round, the paper established a quantitative analysis model on the economic efficiency affected by the change of the regenerative stages of turbine in an energy unit that burns coal. Using a 600MW unit as the subject of the study, the paper quantitatively analyzed the effect of the change of the regenerative stages of a turbine on the rate of heat consumption, boiler efficiency, the electricity consumption rate of the power plant and the standard coal usage rate for electricity generation under different conditions. It is shown by the research that, when one steam extraction phase is added before the fourth stage of the low-pressure stage of turbine, the unit economic efficiency is the best. In addition, under the respective condition of 100%THA, 75%THA, 50%THA and 40%THA, the standard coal burn rate for a unit power supply can be lowered to 0.78 g/(kW•h), 0.78 g/(kW•h), 0.84 g/(kW•h) and 0.75 g/(kW•h) respectively. The research may supply a conceptual guidance for the optimal design and operation of the change of a regenerative system in a coal-fired power unit.

Author Keywords: standard coal burn rate for power generation

articleTitle: Fine-Grained Access Control System for Multi-User Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the increasing adoption of cloud computing, data owners often outsource IoT-generated data to cloud servers, especially in multi-user scenarios where scalability is crucial. However, semi-trusted cloud servers may infer sensitive information from these data transfers, and collusion between malicious users and cloud servers could lead to unauthorized access to other users’ data, raising significant privacy concerns. Without ensuring data isolation and enforcing effective permissions management, multi-user environments face risks of data leakage and unauthorized access. To address these challenges, robust access control mechanisms are essential. While traditional methods, such as Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Access Control Lists (ACL), are straightforward to implement, they lack scalability and flexibility, making them unsuitable for dynamic, multi-user scenarios. In contrast, Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) provides flexible and fine-grained access management, well-suited to such environments. We propose a Fine-Grained Access Control (FGAC) system based on ABAC to ensure efficient and adaptable access management in multi-user cloud environments, incorporating attribute-based encryption to enhance data security in untrusted cloud infrastructures.

articleTitle: An Improved InceptionTime Model for Pattern Synchronization in Covert Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The rapid development of signal recognition technology has brought security risks to communication. How to counter various types of signal recognition has always been a key issue in the field of covert communication. With the iteration of blind detection technology, traditional signal concealment schemes can no longer meet the need for anti-interception. Therefore, this paper implements a transform domain modulation of signals based on butterfly operation transformation, mapping signals to the transform domain and making the signals monitored by third parties noise. Based on this type of data set, this paper proposes a time series classification network based on InceptionTime and Omni-Scale, which can use convolution kernels of different sizes to extract multi-scale receptive fields and successfully reduce the error rate of signal classification from 1.2% to 0.7%, improving the reliability of covert communication.

articleTitle: Communication Base Station Traffic Prediction Based on Nonlinear Regression-LSTM Decomposition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Communication base station traffic prediction can help network service providers predict the peak hours of network traffic, so as to carry out network expansion and load balancing in advance, and keep the users getting a smooth network experience even during the peak hours of the network. In order to accurately predict traffic usage in different time periods, we first constructed a nonlinear regression model, then solved the parameters in the algorithm, and finally got the image of our predicted nonlinear function and compared it with the real value, and found that there are some small swings. Finally, we use the LSTM recurrent neural network to predict the swing term. The final flow prediction is obtained which is very close to the real situation. The model performance was verified with MAE, MAPE and RMSE metrics respectively, and the results showed that the values of the three metrics were 0.1873, 0.0978 and 0.2260 respectively.

articleTitle: Automatic generation algorithm of power report summary based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study proposes a novel summary generation algorithm that combines TF-IDF, BERT, and Seq2Seq models and aims to automate summary generation of professional reports in the power industry. Firstly, the TF-IDF algorithm is used to identify key terms and topics in power reports to extract the most representative and informative content segments, and then these segments are deeply semantic analyzed by BERT model to enhance the understanding of expertise in the power domain. Finally, the BERT-encoded vector sequence is input into the Seq2Seq framework to generate a coherent and content-rich summary. This combined algorithm takes advantage of complementary advantages, covers the whole process from keyword extraction to semantic understanding to summary generation, and can deal with complex domain knowledge to ensure the professionalism and accuracy of the summary.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithms for Coordinated Interaction of Massive Source-Load-Storage Resources in Spot Markets
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The high penetration of renewable energy resources in power systems introduces challenges such as peak load shifting and frequent start-up and shut-down of thermal power units. Enhancing the flexibility and economic efficiency of thermal units in electricity spot markets is crucial to address these issues. This paper presents an optimization model for the coordinated interaction of source-load-storage resources. The model accounts for start-up and shut-down costs based on the minimum generation cost declared by market players. A case study demonstrates the reliability and optimality of the proposed approach, showing significant improvements in total cost and unit behavior. The results underline the importance of integrating diverse energy resources and optimizing their coordination to achieve a stable and efficient power system.

articleTitle: Forecast analysis of railway passenger flow based on time series analysis and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper aims to employ time series analysis and the Long Short-Term Memory network model to accurately forecast and analyze railway passenger flow, thereby enhancing the efficiency of transportation planning and management. Initially, we collected historical monthly passenger flow data for railway transportation. Through time series preprocessing, we identified and addressed trends and missing values to ensure the accuracy of the model input. The LSTM network is capable of capturing long-term dependencies. During the model training process, we utilized cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning to enhance the model’s generalization ability and prediction accuracy. The experimental results demonstrate the LSTM model’s clear superiority in predicting railway passenger flow, with a significantly lower prediction error compared to traditional time series models such as ARIMA. Additionally, a sensitivity analysis was conducted to assess the impact of various factors on the forecast outcomes, providing valuable insights for policymakers.

articleTitle: A Driver Fatigue Modeling Method Based on Enhanced EEG-EOG Fusion Network for Human-Machine Co-Driving
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Driver fatigue detection serves as an essential tool in the process of human-machine co-driving, capable of promptly alerting intelligent systems to assume control of the vehicle. The detection of driver fatigue based on EEG signals currently stands as a primary method for assessing the mental state of individuals. However, at the same time, there are still some problems with EEG signals, such as being prone to noise interference and low cross-subject recognition rate. In addressing the aforementioned issues, this study introduces a method for modeling driver fatigue through the fusion of features extracted from EEG and EOG signals. The proposed model incorporates high-precision EEG equipment and good cross-subject EOG equipment as input. Comprising EEGNet, SANet (Spatial Attention Network), SCONV (and Separable Convolutional Network), the model employs a multi-modal approach to assess driver performance and quantify fatigue. The model effectiveness was verified on the SEED-VIG data set. The test results show that the recognition accuracy of this method reaches 91%, which is better than the currently popular model. At the same time, the cross-subject recognition accuracy test was conducted, and the average accuracy reached 87%, which proved the generalization performance of the model across subjects and verified the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Telecom User Portrait Based on Integrated Learning and Customer Stratification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The continuous advancement of computer network technology has led to an increasing flow of information for enterprises and customers. Currently, telecom companies only categorize customers based on their value, neglecting other important customer characteristics. To better understand and identify customers, this paper proposes the integration of user portraits into telecom enterprises in order to mitigate the risk of pipeline processing. The construction of user portraits is essential for comprehending customer needs and implementing targeted marketing strategies. By enhancing the RFMN model to more accurately assess telecom customer value and utilizing an integrated model for customer stratification, we can optimize clustering effects. Subsequently, customer feature extraction is conducted to accumulate numerous attribute labels and construct user portraits for precision marketing purposes. This approach not only enables companies to gain a deeper understanding of customer needs but also helps reduce costs while facilitating faster decision-making for customers, ultimately leading to improved satisfaction and loyalty.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Network Course in Intelligent Image Acquisition Education System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The Internet, big data, and intelligent robots have transformed online education. This study introduces an Enhanced Convolutional Neural Network (CNN+) model optimized with refined weight initialization and strategic activation functions for image recognition. The CNN+ model achieves 99.5% accuracy on MNIST and 75.2% on CIFAR-10, with the Sigmoid-ReLU hybrid boosting performance to 99.2% and 72.3% respectively. These optimizations underscore the importance of strategic CNN architecture choices in enhancing performance, supporting advancements in online education platforms. The CNN+ model represents a significant breakthrough in image recognition for online education.

articleTitle: Autonomous and Manual Vehicles System Based on 5G-Enabled Intelligent Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: It is anticipated that the intelligent transportation system (ITS) will continue to have a mix of manual and autonomous cars for many years to come. Therefore, before driverless vehicles become completely mainstream, it is essential to address the concerns about safety raised by this mix of manual and autonomous vehicles. Blended traffic structures: security as well as comfort considerations are greatly impacted by the problems autonomous cars present, such as the ITS system has grown more complicated. There has been a low intentions identification rate and poor immediate performance when anticipating the driving path. Consequently, research is needed to create an increasingly advanced Intelligent Transportation System (ITS), and self-driving cars need to be able to predict their path in real time depending on the traffic conditions surrounding them. In this study, we describe a deep learning-based traffic safety method for an ITS that combines human drivers with autonomous vehicles. In 5G-enabled ITS, this technique uses two information sets as network inputs to Bidirectional Long-short term memory (BiLSTM) networks: one for driving trajectories and the other for normal driving. The softmax function computes the probability matrix for each aim. The average of each rule in a decision layer is then fused to get the final intended probabilities. With intentions identification rates of 91.58% and 90.88% for left and right lanes moveings, accordingly, the experimental outcomes demonstrate that the suggested strategy satisfactorily resolves the lanes shift problem in a mixed traffic scenario and enhances accuracy and real-time intention detection.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of E-Commerce Market Trend Prediction Model Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this study, a model of e-commerce market trend prediction based on big data analytics, Gated recurrent Unit (GRU) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is proposed. Firstly, the big data processing framework Spark was used to collect multi-source data from the e-commerce platform, including user behavior and sales records, and Spark SQL was used for data cleaning and preprocessing. Next, the GRU model is used to process time series data to capture the time dependence of the e-commerce market for trend prediction. GRU effectively controls the forgetting and memory of historical information through update gate and reset gate, so as to improve the prediction accuracy. To further enhance model performance, this study incorporates the PSO algorithm to fine-tune the hyperparameters of the GRU, such as the learning rate and the number of hidden layer nodes. By iteratively optimizing the particle swarm, the model can efficiently search for the best parameter combination, thereby improving its predictive accuracy. Ultimately, the effectiveness and precision of the proposed method in forecasting e-commerce market trends are validated through model evaluation. The model combines the big data processing ability of Spark, the time series modeling advantages of GRU and the global optimization ability of PSO, which is suitable for market trend prediction in complex e-commerce environment.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Evolution Method of Command and Control Structures in UAV Swarm Operations Based on Potential Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Based on the analysis of factors influencing the combat mission process, considering heterogeneous nodes, constraint relationships, and various influencing factors, this study proposes a command and control structure evaluation method based on the concept of potential energy in the military operations domain for unmanned swarm combat. The adaptive evolution of the command and control structure for unmanned swarms under dynamic tasks is investigated, where the potential energy reward for stage tasks and the structural adjustment cost constitute the evolution benefits. A mathematical model for the adaptive evolution of the command and control structure is constructed with the objective of maximizing the evolution sequence benefits. An algorithm based on reinforcement learning (PPO) and genetic algorithms (GA) is designed to solve the command and control structure evolution sequence under dynamic tasks. GA is used to search for command and control structures adapted to different stage tasks, while PPO is used to search for the evolution path under stage task transitions.

articleTitle: Taekwondo action recognition model based on deep learning and key point matching technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to solve the problems in Taekwondo action recognition and key point matching, this paper proposes a hybrid matching model that combines YOLOv8 and an improved dynamic time warping (DDTW) algorithm. The model uses YOLOv8 to detect key points in each frame of the video. When the feature points are lost due to occlusion, the model tries to use the information of adjacent frames to compensate. At the same time, in order to reduce jitter, the key point coordinate sequence is smoothed by a low-pass filter. The key frames are matched by the DDTW algorithm, and the action score is calculated according to the best path found by the algorithm. The scoring basis includes the cumulative cosine similarity, action fluency and accuracy. The experimental results show that by combining the images of the three perspectives, the model has achieved significant improvement in recognition accuracy, especially in the key frame combination extracted at the quartile position, the highest recognition accuracy of the front view and the right view reached 92.1% and 94.3% respectively. The method shows strong robustness in noise and speed change processing, and is suitable for motion analysis, rehabilitation training and sports science.

articleTitle: Emotion measurement method based on improved temporal global principal component analysis and Seq2Seq model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study focuses on measuring investor sentiment and its impact on stock market behavior. By integrating an improved time-series global principal component analysis and Seq2Seq model, the aim is to address the challenges in quantifying investor sentiment and predicting market behavior. In this paper, we use a modified time series global principal component analysis approach to process market data, extract key features, and combine it with the Seq2Seq model to predict the correlation between sentiment indices and market trading behaviors (e.g., turnover rate and trading volume). This study ensured the effectiveness and predictive accuracy of the model through rigorous feature selection and model training, including the use of Kendall correlation analysis and Granger causality test. The model training and validation adopted a 7:2:1 training validation testing dataset partitioning ratio to enhance the model's generalization ability and prediction accuracy. The experimental results showed that the accuracy of the Seq2Seq model in predicting the correlation between trading volume and investor sentiment reached 0.8713 and 0.9158 before and after adding sentiment index features, respectively, verifying the effectiveness and reliability of the Seq2Seq model in measuring investor sentiment and predicting market behavior. This study provides a practical and feasible solution for automated investor sentiment monitoring, and lays the foundation for further exploration of multi-dimensional market data fusion and real-time prediction technology.

Author Keywords: improved time series global principal component Analysis

articleTitle: A multi-level and multi-agent collaborative control platform for city-scale virtual power plants based on a cloud-pipe-edge-end fusion architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the continuous expansion and complexity of urban power grids, traditional power control methods are difficult to meet the needs of multi-agent, multi-energy and multi-level in modern power grids. To address this problem, this paper proposes a multi-level and multi-agent collaborative control platform for urban-scale virtual power plants based on a cloud-pipe-edge-end fusion architecture. By introducing technologies such as cloud computing, edge computing and the Internet of Things, the platform designs a multi-level control architecture that includes functional modules such as physical information modeling, resource aggregation optimization, automatic power control and instruction decomposition. The innovation of the platform lies in its ability to enable the full process of adjustable resources on the load side of the virtual power plant to participate in the automatic generation control (AGC) and automatic voltage control (AVC) of the power grid, and integrates intelligent monitoring and traceability technology of electric carbon, providing real-time and efficient power control and carbon emission management. Through actual case analysis and verification, the platform is significantly superior to traditional systems in terms of supply and demand balance, response speed, energy efficiency optimization and carbon emission management, which improves the overall operation efficiency and stability of the power grid and provides strong technical support for the intelligent management of urban power grids.

articleTitle: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Imaged-Based Lighting
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper presents a novel neural radiance field rendering method named 3D-IBLGS, which integrates prefiltered radiance fields to address global illumination in large-scale scenes. By extending the 3DGS formulation with image-space constraints, 3D-IBLGS optimizes implicit lighting distributions within neural images, capturing detailed spatial variations in lighting. The method efficiently renders general scenes while maintaining the quality of the original 3DGS and allows scene editing by changing materials or adding objects. Compared to Monte Carlo integration methods relying on environmental lighting, 3D-IBLGS demonstrates superior performance in decomposition and image synthesis, successfully segmenting the global illumination response of image components.

articleTitle: Research on key technologies of multi-agent game decision distributed learning system for agent equipment decision parameter optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The optimization of decision parameters for equipment in the Intelligent agent domain is becoming increasingly paramount, driven by advancements in modern technology and the intricacies of battlefield environments. Multi-agent game theory, by simulating the interactions and confrontations of various agents under diverse scenarios, can authentically replicate the complex dynamic relationships inherent in the battlefield. Meanwhile, distributed learning systems demonstrate unique advantages in managing vast data sets and intricate computations. The synergy of these two approaches not only enhances the accuracy and timeliness of decision-making but also propels the innovation and advancement of intelligent agent technology. The transition from theory to practical application encompasses numerous critical technologies, including the construction of multi-agent game models, algorithm design, and the establishment of distributed architectures, all aimed at achieving efficient and precise optimization of intelligent agent equipment decision parameters.

articleTitle: Research on Target Recognition Based on Deep Feature Fusion of Infrared and Visible Light Images
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: It is expected that unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing target recognition will have a broad range of applications in fields such as smart cities, traffic monitoring, and disaster monitoring. However, remote sensing images have relatively small targets, and they are also affected by factors such as weather, lighting, and occlusion. This makes target detection and recognition difficult. In order to improve the accuracy of target recognition, this paper proposes a dual modal image depth feature fusion method for recognizing unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensor images. The method includes dual modal image registration, and a dual modal image depth feature fusion method based on the yolov7 model. By constructing a bimodal dataset and using the HOPC operator for image registration, strict registration was achieved with manual annotation assistance. The yolov7-dual model proposed in this article, through pixel level fusion and CAFM attention mechanism, ultimately increased the mAP value from 0.424 to 0.657, significantly exceeding expectations.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Modeling Methods Combining Genetic Algorithm with Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As an optimization algorithm that imitates the natural selection and genetic mechanism, genetic algorithm applied in the combination with the computer technology, gradually obtained rapid development along with the computer network and information technology. Supported by a comprehensive account of essential elements, the basic theories of genetic algorithm are introduced in this paper, as well as how applications of genetic algorithm have been supported with the use of computer technology. This paper focuses on the optimization modeling method, through the use of genetic algorithm in combination with computer technology, whose efficiency has been validated through case analysis. Aiming at the problem of genetic algorithm, this paper presents an improved genetic algorithm based on variable domain to solve the traveling salesman problem. It finally summarizes the research findings, outlines the future development trends, and underlines that this study opens new directions for the application of genetic algorithms in the field of computer technology, while providing effective technical support for optimization modelling.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Maritime Rescue Aircraft Decision Support System for the Middle and Far Seas of the South China Sea
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of maritime rescue aircraft application decision in the middle and far seas of the South China Sea, such as insufficient of the emergency plan, low efficiency of decision making and poor real-time and implementability of rescue plan generating etc, this paper proposes a design method of maritime rescue decision system for aircraft based on emergency plan and scenario analysis. According to the application conditions of our country's maritime rescue aircrafts, combined with the key features of classic maritime accidents and the South China Sea, this paper completes the construction of the system and realizes the real-time and efficient application decision making of maritime rescue aircraft in middle and far seas. This method uses the information extraction technology based on large language model to extract the key features of the accident from the history accdents and emergency plans, forms the meta scenarios, and constructs the meta scenarios base based on accident types and levels. When a maritime accident occers, based on dynamic scenario analysis and SBERT model, maritime accidents are classified and graded. Then the method selects the meta scenario set that matches the current accident needs from the meta scenario base, and constructs action instructions through instruction templates. It uses the task planning technology to optimize and adjust the priority of rescue instructions, and finally generates a feasible real-time rescue plan. Maritime rescue aircraft decision support system fully utilizes the standard of the emergency plans and the instantaneity of the scenario analysis method, generates an optimized rescue plan that is closely related to the maritime accident information. The system further improves the accuracy, scientific and intelligent level of the maritime rescue aircraft application in the maritime rescue decision making process.

articleTitle: Image Feature Extraction with Fourier Transform and Multi-task Swin-Transformer for Alzheimer’s Disease Prediction and Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) patients often miss the optimal treatment time due to their late onset and unclear early clinical manifestations. There is little difference between the CT images of the brain of AD patients and normal people, and the efficiency of manual diagnosis is low. However, classic models (such as Resnet, Swin Transformer, CNN, etc.) do not have strong targeting for brain disease diagnosis, and they are more inclined towards general classification tasks, so there is great room for improving the accuracy of the model. This article (FTM Swin) is based on a learnable mask mechanism with algorithm combined with SVM and swin-transformer, to filter and extract features in the frequency domain graph of 3D images. Fast Fourier transform (FFT) is used to achieve the interaction and combination of frequency domain and spatial domain feature matrices, ultimately completing the classification task of data points in the time domain, which simplifies the feature extraction process and makes the classification boundary of the classifier more accurate. Subsequently, this article utilized the ADNI brain imaging dataset and trained the previous classifier model using a dataset annotated with the hippocampus region, which plays a crucial role in Alzheimer’s disease lesions. This further enhanced the model’s ability to detect lesion sites and provided information on the stage of the condition. Compared with the other eight advanced models for image classification tasks in the past three years, FTM-Swin has an accuracy of 97.18% on the validation set, with the best performance.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation algorithm of student physical training effect based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to develop an effective method to evaluate the progress of students after specific physical training in order to provide data support for physical education in schools. Firstly, a large number of students' physical training data were collected from a number of schools, including physical fitness indicators such as height, weight standing long jump distance, 50-meter sprint performance and other dimensions, and combined with the implementation of training plans and other information, a comprehensive data set was constructed. During the stage of data preprocessing, statistical methods are employed to detect and manage missing values and outliers, thereby guaranteeing the quality of the data. Through feature engineering, a number of key variables are extracted to help predict, such as the physical difference before and after training, training frequency, and the length of each training. Next, we applied three different machine learning models: Among the trio of networks—the Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM), Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), and Deep Neural Network (DNN)—the LSTM is utilized to ascertain the optimal decision boundary for differentiating students of varying physical capabilities. By incorporating multiple decision trees, the GAN enhances the stability and precision of predictions. The DNN, on the other hand, employs multi-layer perceptron structures to discern intricate patterns within the data. Subsequently, a novel neural network model, designated as LGNN, is formulated through the amalgamation of these three models for effect assessment, and its superiority is validated on a genuine real-world dataset.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Integrated Primary and Distribution Power Grid Dispatch Training System Based on a Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: To address the current mismatch between simulation training systems and existing training needs as well as management simulations, this paper designs an integrated primary and distribution power grid dispatch simulation training system based on a cloud platform, taking into account the operational characteristics and management modes of active distribution networks and integrated primary and distribution grids. By incorporating simulations of integrated primary and distribution power grids, operational mechanisms of transformation and distribution equipment, distribution automation, and a training management system, this platform provides ground distribution operators with a fully digital simulation environment that is highly consistent with reality for "learning-practicing-testing-evaluating" integration. It effectively enhances dispatchers' abilities in operational monitoring, control operations, and emergency handling under complex distribution network structures, diversified source-grid-load-storage integration, integrated primary and distribution grids, and bidirectional interactive power flow modes.

articleTitle: Research on Competitive Evaluation Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Genetic algorithms are machine learning algorithms inspired by the theory of natural evolution. By mimicking the process of natural selection and reproduction, genetic algorithms can provide high-quality solutions to a wide range of problems involving search, optimization, and learning. It can overcome some of the obstacles encountered by traditional search and optimization algorithms, especially for problems with many parameters and complex mathematical representations. To extend its application, this paper applies it to more subjective judging sessions. Firstly, after in-depth analysis, collation, and classification of judging data from several innovation competitions, genetic algorithms are subsequently used to optimize the allocation of works and judging experts, and the current standard score judging scheme is improved by non-linear correction of parameters. The results of the final data experiment show that the model greatly improves the concentration of scores and judging power and provides a reference for similar subjective scenario modelling optimization.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Multimodal Knowledge Graph in Construction Risk Management of Transmission and Transformation Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a construction risk management method based on multimodal knowledge graph, aiming to improve the risk identification and prediction capabilities in the construction process. The system combines advanced natural language processing (NLP) algorithms, which can automatically extract and integrate construction-related information from multi-source heterogeneous data, and construct a comprehensive knowledge graph covering multimodal data such as text, images, and videos. In terms of algorithm design, an improved NLP model is used to conduct in-depth semantic analysis and association mining of text data, while integrating image recognition and video analysis technologies to achieve all-round data integration and analysis of complex construction scenes. In the system simulation stage, this paper conducts comprehensive verification through a large amount of actual construction data, focusing on evaluating the risk identification and prediction performance of the system in different scenarios. The simulation results show that the accuracy of this method in identifying construction risks has reached more than 95%, and the error rate of predicting construction risks is controlled within 5%, which significantly improves the accuracy and efficiency of construction risk management, fully verifies the practicality and reliability of the system, and provides strong technical support for construction management.

Author Keywords: Power transmission and transformation project construction

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Employee Turnover Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Given the current challenging labor market, many organizations are grappling with significant issues related to employee turnover. This turnover can lead to considerable economic detriments for businesses, rendering the reduction of turnover rates a critical priority. This research leverages an open-source dataset on employee turnover, executing comprehensive data preprocessing and feature engineering. It conducts descriptive statistical analysis and correlation assessments and explores the application of various clustering algorithms such as K-means and DBSCAN to HR data. The study evaluates the effectiveness of these methods through comparative analysis, providing insights into the most suitable clustering techniques for handling HR datasets. The study implements a strategy based on the Random Forest algorithm, coupled with a Grid Search technique, to enhance both the accuracy and generalizability of the classification model. This approach not only boosts the predictive capabilities of the model but also showcases an innovative application of machine learning techniques in model selection and optimization. The findings of this study serve as a valuable resource for corporate management, offering strategic guidance to mitigate unnecessary employee turnover, thereby fostering a more stable workforce environment.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent anti-collision system of inland waterway lock based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Once a ship carrying dangerous goods collides with the lock, the consequences are very serious. Based on the channel project of the Beijing-Hangzhou Canal and the Yangtze River, this paper systematically describes the active lock collision avoidance system based on deep learning platform and its key technologies, introduces the technical route of the active collision avoidance system. We develop the system software architecture, control core algorithm and the active lock collision avoidance device based on the blocking device. It provides technical support for the industrial application of the active anti-collision system of inland lock.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Situational Awareness in Hospital Network Security
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of medical informatization, the diversification and complexity of hospital network services have increased significantly, raising higher demands for network security. Current hospital network security defenses primarily rely on traditional rule-based interception and single-layer protection, lacking comprehensive and proactive situational awareness capabilities. This paper aims to develop a comprehensive situational awareness model for hospital network security to enhance threat identification, early warning, and prediction. First, to address the complexity of hospital networks and facilitate element acquisition, principal component analysis (PCA) is employed to reduce the dimensionality of network access traffic data, removing redundant attributes and improving the speed and accuracy of threat classification and prediction. Second, a multi-dimensional hierarchical situational awareness index system based on multi-source data is constructed, with indexes quantified using entropy weighting and hierarchical analysis, enabling an accurate evaluation of hospital cybersecurity. Finally, a time series-based prediction method is proposed, utilizing the seasonal autoregressive moving average (SARMA) model to effectively forecast the hospital's network security situation, providing practical guidance for real-world security management.

articleTitle: Research on Linear Programming and Grey Wolf Optimization Algorithm in Energy Storage System Configuration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper focuses on the research and application of linear optimization algorithm and grey Wolf optimization algorithm, takes the energy storage system configuration optimization of the park energy system as the research object, and discusses in detail the similarities and differences and advantages of the energy storage system configuration under the three modes of independent operation, joint operation and collaborative configuration of wind storage. Firstly, a linear programming model for optimizing system configuration was established to determine the optimal energy storage power and capacity. In addition, under the consideration of State of Charge (SOC) and other constraints, the grey Wolf optimization algorithm was applied to further optimize the energy storage system configuration of independent parking lots to improve the accuracy and reliability of the optimization results. Secondly, the optimal energy storage configuration of the independent park is analyzed in detail, and the optimal energy storage scheme is deduced through the solution of the model and algorithm, which reflects the superiority of linear programming and grey Wolf optimization algorithm. The final focus is on developing a coordinated future configuration scheme for wind and solar storage. At the same time, the peak and valley electricity factor is introduced into the linear programming model, and the optimized grey Wolf algorithm is used to obtain the optimized energy scheduling and energy storage utilization strategy of the park's power generation and electricity price changes in the next five years.

articleTitle: An improved RCBT model and its application to sentiment analysis of movie comments
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Sentiment analysis of social media comments is crucial for understanding public opinion and trends. However, existing models like Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers-Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BERT-BiLSTM) face challenges with long texts and complex sentiment expressions. To address these issues, this paper proposes an improved RoBERTa-CNN-BiLSTM-Transformers (RCBT) model for sentiment analysis of social media comments. Specifically, a CNN module is introduced to enhance the model's capability in extracting local features, efficiently capturing local patterns such as phrases and word combinations, thereby improving sentiment analysis accuracy. Additionally, the Transformers mechanism is incorporated to address the high computational complexity and low training efficiency of BiLSTM in handling long-range dependencies. The self-attention mechanism in Transformers allows for better capture of long-range dependencies without significantly increasing computational complexity, thus enhancing the model's performance in long text sentiment analysis. Finally, RoBERTa is employed for text feature extraction and representation. Compared to BERT, RoBERTa has stronger pre-training capabilities and can handle larger datasets, offering more accurate predictions in sentiment analysis tasks. The proposed RCBT model is validated on the IMDB movie review dataset. Experimental results show that the model performs excellently in classification tasks, with precision (P), recall (R), and accuracy (ACC) reaching 99.80% on the training set, fully validating the model's effectiveness. Compared to other models, the proposed model achieves the highest accuracy (ACC) and F1 score on the test set, confirming its superiority.

articleTitle: Personalized Recommendation of Teacher Learning Behavior Using Expression Recognition Algorithms Integrated by Deep Learning and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: At present, online teacher training platforms represented by Chinese university catechism have become an important way for teachers' professional development. However, the course dropout rate of such platforms is very high. For this reason, this paper intends to utilize a combination of deep learning and augmented learning to monitor the teacher's facial expression in the process of online teaching in real time, so as to realize the analysis of the teacher's learning behavior and emotional state. This paper proposes to investigate a facial expression recognition method based on a combination of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), using augmented learning strategies to train and optimize the proposed model to better understand the teacher's emotional response and learning needs. In this paper, we use machine learning and other methods to study teachers' emotional changes in the specific teaching process and conduct correlation analysis with them to find out the important factors affecting their learning effectiveness. When the teacher's emotion reaches a pleasant state, the learning completion rate is significantly increased by 20%, indicating that the emotional state has a significant positive impact on learning behavior and performance. Through the in-depth analysis of teachers' facial expressions and learning behaviors, we can optimize the appropriateness and engagement of the training content, as well as provide new research ideas and methods for educational technology research and promote the development of educational informatization.

articleTitle: Development of a Movie AI Question Answering System Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the increasing influence of the internet, information retrieval technology needs to be continuously upgraded. The development of the internet drives the transformation of the film industry, with an increase in the number of online movies, a flourishing of professional film websites and forums, and an increasing influence of online comments. There are still shortcomings in the relationship between the internet and film evaluation, and further exploration is needed. The development of this system adopts a front-end and back-end separation mode, with Vue technology architecture used in the front-end and Django framework used in the back-end. The knowledge graph can organize and express movie information, providing data support for intelligent question answering and comment systems. The system constructs a graph by collecting movie data, achieving storage, management, and querying, providing intelligent and personalized services, and designing movie review functions to provide comprehensive information and evaluation references; The question answering function is implemented through natural language processing technology (NLP) and graph database technology, which can recognize the user’s query intention and retrieve relevant information, generate accurate and concise answers. Its core module is the movie AI question answering function based on Neo4j. After the user raises a question, the comment system will parse the question and construct a Cypher query statement. After execution, the result will be returned and displayed to the user, achieving intelligent answers and personalized services. In system design, the connection between the movie AI question answering module and the Neo4j database is crucial. This connection enables effective communication and information exchange between user questions and movie knowledge graphs, providing users with convenient and accurate movie related information. Through deep integration with the Neo4j database, the system can better understand user needs and make corresponding intelligent responses, improving user experience and system practicality. The development of this system brings certain application reference value to similar movie question answering systems.

articleTitle: Research on Hemorrhagic Stroke Based on K-medoids Cluster Analysis and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Data mining is an effective computer-aided analysis technology, which can uncover hidden information from large data sets and provide basis for decision-making. At the same time, clustering analysis, as an important branch of data mining, is also widely used in various fields, among which the k-medoids clustering algorithm has better robustness and anti-noise ability than the traditional k-means algorithm. In order to expand the value of these two computer analysis techniques in medical applications, this paper attempts to combine k-medoids cluster analysis and data mining methods to apply them to the analysis and research of clinical hematoma. Specifically, this research first used feedforward neural network to construct a simulation of edema volume changes, which laid a foundation for subsequent cluster analysis. Then, the k-medoids algorithm was used to divide the different edema patients into three clusters. On this basis, the therapeutic effect of multiple treatment modalities on link edema was analyzed by controlling for a single variable. Finally, Pearson correlation analysis was used to explore the treatment options most related to the volume of hematoma. In general, this research successfully applied the data mining technique and k-medoids clustering algorithm to the field of clinical medicine, which provides a useful reference for the application of more computer analysis methods in the field of medical and health care. In the future, we can further explore how to integrate more machine learning algorithms into medical data analysis, to provide more intelligent support for clinical diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: Optimized Placement Study of 3D Printing Models Based on Nelder-Mead Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The rapid development of 3D printing technology has driven a transformation in the manufacturing industry. However, the optimization of model placement remains a significant challenge in ensuring print quality and improving production efficiency. This key issue focuses on the rational addition of supports and the precise modeling of surface error volume, aiming to explore more effective model placement algorithms. The research findings reveal that appropriate support design can not only effectively reduce support defects during the printing process but also significantly enhance structural stability. Through the analysis of patch normal vectors, the study proposes two support configuration strategies and emphasizes the central role of accurate error assessment in model optimization. The main objective of this research is to deepen the understanding of the characteristics and printing behavior of 3D printing models through systematic technical analysis, thereby providing a reliable basis for theoretical research and industrial practice. Optimizing model placement is not only a technical challenge but also a comprehensive test for 3D printing designers and engineers, influencing the prospects for various innovative applications. As the research progresses, the constructed optimization model demonstrates its potential in improving print quality and reducing material waste, especially in addressing printing tasks that require complex shapes and high precision, showcasing its strong application value. This exploration of 3D printing embodies profound reflections and aspirations for the future of manufacturing, igniting anticipation and enthusiasm for new technologies both within and outside the industry.

articleTitle: Research on Dispute Case Relationship Analysis and Prediction Based on Graph Convolutional Network (GCN)
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, a method combining Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) and BERT model is proposed to analyze and predict the relationship between dispute cases in depth. By constructing a case relationship graph and applying GCN to learn the complex relationship patterns in the graph, and using BERT to capture the deep semantic information contained in the judgment documents, the comprehensive and deep learning of case features is realized, which innovatively combines the structural information processing ability of GCN and the text understanding advantages of BERT. A comprehensive model that can accurately predict the development trend and relationship of cases is constructed, which shows significant advantages especially in dealing with highly related and semantic complex dispute cases.

articleTitle: Research on human-computer interaction personalized experience algorithm based on user experience theory
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to study the role of user experience in automotive human-computer interaction product design, this paper first introduces adversarial q network and deep q network content. Adversarial Q-Network (AQN) is an innovative framework that combines the advantages of Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Deep Q-Network (DQN) to enhance the personalized automotive user experience based on human-computer interaction. AQN uses the powerful generation capabilities of GAN to create realistic and diverse user behavior data, thereby enhancing the authenticity and diversity of the training set for use by DQN. The GAN segment generates synthetic but authentic user interaction data that is used to train the DQN to make more informed decisions to personalize each driver's in-car experience. This dual network architecture enables AQN to dynamically adapt to individual preferences and optimize all aspects of the driving experience, such as climate control, entertainment systems, and navigation AIDS. Finally, by comparing the model architecture with traditional machine learning, this paper verifies that the AQN model proposed in this paper not only improves the accuracy of personalized recommendation, but also improves the overall user satisfaction and user engagement. The feasibility and effectiveness of this model in the optimization of automobile users' personalized experience are proved.

articleTitle: Fault Detection and Prevention Mechanism Driven by Sensors in Electrical Automation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This article analyzes the various factors that cause faults in electrical automation equipment in complex working environments and long-term operation. Based on these analyses, ANN is used to monitor and analyze the data collected by equipment sensors, in order to identify and predict potential faults. The study also proposes a series of preventive strategies and data-driven preventive maintenance to help prevent failures, improve equipment reliability and service life. Experimental data shows that the accuracy of fault detection using Artificial Neural Network (ANN) is significantly higher than that of traditional k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), with an average accuracy of 88.155%, while KNN is only 72.08%. Especially in the best case, the accuracy of the ANN model is as high as 97.4%, demonstrating its advantage in identifying fault features in complex systems. By implementing sensor driven fault detection and prevention mechanisms, this article can not only improve the reliability and safety of electrical automation systems, but also enhance overall production efficiency and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Research on the Open Source Components Security of Intelligent Connected Vehicles Based on SCA
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The booming development of intelligent connected vehicles (ICVs) is accompanied by numerous security incidents, so the security research on ICVs has become more and more active. However, on the basis of combing the existing literature, this study finds that the security research of ICVs has the status quo of broad perspective, qualitative description and little domestic research. Based on the core viewpoint of "software defined vehicles", the first study of open source component security research based on the samples of domestically produced ICVs parts and software component analysis is carried out. The study found that firstly, open source components are widely used in ICVs parts, and each ICV uses 112 open source components on average. Secondly, open source components contain a large number of vulnerabilities, with high risk and serious vulnerabilities accounting for nearly 50% of the total, and the components that have been used more often contain more vulnerabilities. Thirdly, it is found that most of the vulnerabilities are caused by a small number of common weaknesses and some mitigation measures are proposed for the vulnerability management of open source components from the perspective of common weaknesses. The study can increase the importance of open source components in the security research of ICVs and provide a reference for the governance of open source components.

articleTitle: A Rust Removal and Painting Robot for Offshore Wind Turbine Towers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In response to the significant risks and low efficiency associated with traditional manual operations on offshore wind turbine towers, a robotic rust removal and painting system tailored for offshore wind turbine tower cylinders is proposed. This robotic system is designed to replace human involvement in routine inspections, rust removal, cleaning, and anti-corrosion painting tasks on offshore wind turbine tower cylinders. The robot primarily comprises three key components: a chain-driven permanent magnet adhesion walking mechanism, a rust removal unit, and a high-pressure spraying mechanism. It adopts a tracked walking mode, with multiple adhesion units evenly distributed on each track. The rust removal mechanism is mounted at the front of the robot, and three high-pressure spray guns are located at the rear, each equipped with windproof covers. Through the establishment of mathematical models for the robot, static and dynamic analyses are conducted to explore critical values for three scenarios: climbing, sliding, flipping, and forward movement. Based on these critical values, physical models are designed, and performance tests involving climbing, rust removal, and painting are conducted to determine the robot's performance parameters. The robot's overall structure is straightforward, with characteristics such as ease of operation, convenient maintenance, and a high degree of automation. It is not only suitable for rust removal, cleaning, and anti-corrosion painting tasks on offshore wind power equipment but also applicable for routine fault inspections of offshore wind power equipment.

articleTitle: Road vehicle object detection based on improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study is dedicated to road vehicle object detection in intelligent transportation systems. By improving the YOLOv8 algorithm, dynamic snake convolution, EMA attention mechanism, and AlphaGIoU loss function are introduced to address the challenges faced by vehicle detection in complex road environments. In the study, data collected from multiple channels and the COCO public dataset were utilized to cover road target images under different lighting and climate conditions, and a diverse training sample set was constructed. By implementing strict preprocessing measures, the quality of the training data is ensured. The model training and validation adopt a comprehensive loss function to enhance the model's generalization ability and detection accuracy. For the YOLOv8 algorithm, we optimized the network structure and training strategy, particularly by enhancing feature extraction ability through dynamic snake convolution, improving key feature attention through EMA attention mechanism, and optimizing the balance between regression and classification loss through AlphaGIoU loss function. In the experimental verification phase, tests were conducted on image datasets containing multiple targets such as cars, buses, and pedestrians. After model training and testing, the improved YOLOv8 algorithm achieved a mAP value of 0.628 on the test set, verifying the system's vehicle detection ability in complex environments and providing effective technical support for the optimization of intelligent transportation systems.

articleTitle: Analysis and Methodological Advancements in Software-Defined Error Correction Codes
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This article provides a detailed exploration of the principles, development, and applications of Error-Correcting Codes (ECC) across various fields. ECC has the capability to detect and correct errors during data transmission and storage, significantly enhancing data accuracy and system reliability. Particularly in areas such as wireless networks, digital communication, and data storage, ECC technology has become an indispensable component. The article primarily discusses Hamming codes, Reed-Solomon codes, Turbo codes, Low-Density Parity-Check codes (LDPC), and Polar codes, focusing on cutting-edge research. Using LDPC as a case study, it analyzes the principles of traditional ECC methods, highlighting their limitations in handling double-bit errors (DUE), and introduces Software-Defined Error-Correcting Codes (SDECC), which integrate software and hardware technologies to provide more flexible and efficient error handling solutions. Furthermore, through experimental validation combining various traditional ECC methods, it demonstrates that SDECC exhibits significant advantages in recovering data errors and addressing system crashes, particularly in big data environments, effectively preventing the propagation of erroneous data and system failures. These research findings offer new perspectives and potential development directions for the future of ECC technology. By conducting an in-depth analysis and discussion of SDECC technology, this paper not only underscores its application value in modern information society but also showcases the potential and challenges for future development. With advancements in communication technology and computational theory, ECC and its derivative technologies will continue to play a crucial role in ensuring the security and reliability of information transmission.

articleTitle: A Joint Dynamic Domain Adaptation Module and Multi-incentive-aware Based Model for Sentiment Analysis of Autism Paintings
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the development of society, the number of autistic children is increasing, and there is growing concern about their education and development. Autistic children often have difficulties in language expression, social interaction and emotional understanding. In this context, finding new ways to understand the emotions and needs of autistic children has become particularly important. By analyzing the drawings of autistic children and using deep learning models to mine the emotions and information embedded in them, we can provide educators and parents with a more intuitive and in-depth way to understand the inner world of autistic children. As a non-verbal form of expression, paintings can help autistic children release emotions and express their inner thoughts and feelings. Firstly, based on psychological research results, we propose a new image emotion classification network based on multi-incentive awareness, which consists of three phases, i.e., incentive selection (S), feature extraction (O) and emotion prediction (R). In the first phase, in this paper, we select special emotion excitations (color, object, face) by combining existing target detection methods in deep learning. Subsequently, we design three specific networks to extract different emotion features from multiple incentives synchronously, i.e., global network, semantic network, and expression network. Finally, the model combines all the above features for image emotion prediction. Comparative experiments demonstrate that the accuracy of our constructed sentiment analysis model outperforms existing algorithms. After training the above multi-incentive-aware image sentiment analysis model, we design a transfer learning model to map the features learned by the model on the regular image dataset to the drawing dataset of autistic patients. We perform multi-representation feature extraction using a hybrid structure, which consists of multiple sub-structural feature extraction units. At the same time we use several different sub-feature spaces to represent the original image emotional features and perform joint dynamic domain adaptation for domain data in each sub-feature space. Comparative experiments demonstrate that the accuracy of our constructed transfer learning model outperforms existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Using Transformer Models to Separate and Reduce Noise in Speaker Voice in Noisy Conference Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Nowadays, online meetings have become an important way for people to communicate at work. With the application popularization of this meeting form and the emergence of various new functions, people's requirements for voice quality are also continuously rising. Especially in the case of noisy backgrounds and multiple speakers, obtaining clear speech signals and accurately separated speech is still a problem that needs to be solved today. To solve this problem, this study proposes a multi-speaker speech separation and noise reduction system based on the pre-trained model of the SpeechBrain library. This system combines the SpectralMaskEnhancement model and the SepformerSeparation model, respectively used for speech denoising and multi-speaker speech separation in complex noise environments. By combining the advantages of the two models, the separation and denoising effects are effectively improved. The experiment used the LibriMix dataset, and the results showed that this method achieved 18.0 dB in signal-to-noise ratio improvement (SI-SNRi) and 18.3 dB in source-to-distortion ratio improvement (SDRi), significantly improved compared to the traditional Wavesplit and the separate Sepformer model. Through experimental comparison, the fusion model outperformed conventional methods in denoising and speech separation performance, especially in complex scenarios with multi-speaker overlap and strong background noise. The method in this study can effectively improve the voice quality of the conference in noisy backgrounds and multi-speaker scenarios, and play a role in other audio fields.

articleTitle: A Complex Reasoning Framework for Intelligent Learning Assistant Based on Large Language Model and Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Large language models are widely applied in educational scenarios. Students can engage in personalized and interactive learning through intelligent learning assistants installed on various devices. Among these applications, integrating large language models (LLMs) with knowledge graphs to achieve complex reasoning is a key issue. Traditional methods often solve multi-hop query problems based on individual technologies, leading to insufficient accuracy and comprehensiveness in answering complex questions. This paper proposes an intelligent agent framework called K12-Agent, which uses retrieval-enhanced generation, fine-tuning of LLMs integrated with knowledge graphs, and collaborative reasoning to enhance the initiative of the agent in interactions with students. Compared to traditional methods, K12-Agent has improved the accuracy by 15% and the recall rate by 13% when facing complex student questions. Additionally, K12-Agent is more adaptable to the expression methods of younger students, making it more user-friendly.

articleTitle: ARIMA Model Based on Weighted Bagging Algorithm and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: ARIMA model is a statistical method for shortterm prediction of stationary time series, and in the specific modeling process, AIC and BIC criteria are generally used to select the number of hyperparameters of the model, but the AIC and BIC criteria based on the goal of likelihood maximization may not be consistent with the purpose of predicting optimality. In this paper, an improved ARIMA model based on the weighted Bagging algorithm was proposed, in which several ARIMA models were trained by setting all feasible parameter combinations and forming a set of candidate models, and then the weighted Bagging algorithm was used to average the models of several sub-models to obtain an ensemble learning model based on ARIMA. On the one hand, the proposed method can theoretically improve the prediction performance of the original model from the perspective of prediction accuracy, and on the other hand, the method weighs the bias and variance of the prediction model through the model averaging technique. The actual data analysis results show that the proposed method has a significant improvement in prediction accuracy compared with the ARIMA model based on AIC and BIC criteria.

articleTitle: Auxiliary System of Fan Blade Maintenance Based on Augmented Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This research focuses on the auxiliary system of wind turbine blade maintenance based on AR technology, aiming to solve the problems of low efficiency, high risk and difficult information management of traditional wind turbine blade maintenance. The system overlays the blade maintenance knowledge and operation process on the real scene in the form of three-dimensional virtual information through AR technology, providing intuitive operation guidance for maintenance personnel. At the same time, the hololens2 device is used to realize high-precision 3D tracking registration and multiple interactive modes such as gaze, gesture and voice, so as to improve the user experience. The system constructs the knowledge base of blade maintenance, and develops the process flow parser to realize the intelligent recommendation and dynamic update of maintenance information. In addition, the system also integrates the remote expert guidance function to ensure the quality and safety of the maintenance work. This research not only has important theoretical significance, but also provides new ideas and solutions for the maintenance work of the wind power industry, and promotes the healthy and rapid development of the wind power industry.

articleTitle: Advancements in Natural Language Understanding and Applications: A Study on ChatGPT with Novel Approaches to Fairness and Accuracy in Education
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) has evolved significantly since the 1950s, with early research focusing on tasks like machine translation, information retrieval, and text summarization. Initially, most NLP research emphasized syntactic analysis, but the challenge of understanding and processing unstructured text remained. Recent advancements in large-scale language models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT, have revolutionized the field by enabling zero-shot execution of various NLP tasks without task-specific training. ChatGPT, based on the Transformer architecture, represents a major breakthrough in NLP, generating high-quality natural language responses and self-correcting based on dialogue context. This paper investigates the applications of ChatGPT in educational tasks, focusing on enhancing the fairness and accuracy of its responses. Fairness refers to ensuring that users receive consistent and unbiased answers to the same queries, while accuracy involves improving the precision of ChatGPT's outputs, particularly in complex educational tasks such as scientific literature review and content comprehension. We propose novel solutions, including dynamic model weighting for fairness and integrating external knowledge bases to boost accuracy. Experiments conducted on educational tasks demonstrate significant improvements in both fairness and accuracy, showing that the proposed methods enable ChatGPT to provide more reliable and consistent educational support. Our findings suggest that, with these innovations, ChatGPT can play a pivotal role in improving educational outcomes by offering fair access to quality learning content while addressing accuracy challenges. Future work will explore expanding this approach to other fields where NLP plays a crucial role.

articleTitle: System design for reducing underwater positioning error of submersible by using GNSS and underwater acoustic positioning technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This research paper outlines a comprehensive set of models encompassing positioning and rescue schemes, utilizing Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) alongside underwater acoustic positioning technology. The primary focus is on building an efficient and reliable submersible predictive positioning and fault rescue safety system based on comprehensive data collection and analysis. For the first question, we successfully built a predictive model of the actual trajectory of the submersible by using the link between inertial data and the GPS positioning system. The Monte Carlo method is used to determine the uncertainty of prediction with the greatest probability, and the main uncertainties affecting the position deviation of submersible are machine aging and ocean current change. This lays a foundation for the subsequent establishment of the main ship fault search and rescue model, and provides a strong support for the passage of MCMS in safety audit. The establishment of this prediction model provides an important basis for the subsequent response to the failure of submersible. For the second question, we provide methods and schemes for the search and rescue of the main ship. We detect faulty submersibles through buoys, submersibles and magnetic detection devices, feedback the causes of underwater faulty submersibles, and provide methods for the subsequent establishment of the fault search and rescue model of the main ship.
