For the third question, we use the equipment provided by the second question to rescue the submersible when it fails, and establish a search and rescue model under the condition of submersible failure, so as to rescue the faulty submersible in an efficient and reliable way and ensure the personal safety of tourists. For the fourth question, we have extended the prediction model of submersible sailing trajectory and the search and rescue model of the main ship to different tourist sea areas, and realized the touristic formation design of multiple submersibles working together, trying to reduce costs and maximize benefits on the basis of safety. This system will be expanded to cover global tourist regions and scenarios involving multiple submersibles sailing together, enhancing the efficiency and success rate of submersible malfunction incidents.

articleTitle: Research on personalized learning path recommendation model of artificial intelligence in new business
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Due to the flourishing expansion of online education, students' appetite for individualized learning experiences has significantly intensified. Consequently, we introduce a model that utilizes machine learning to recommend personalized learning paths. The model incorporates several algorithms such as collaborative filtering, content recommendation and reinforcement learning. First, we use collaborative filtering algorithms to analyze students' learning behavior data to identify users with similar interests and academic backgrounds. Then, through the content recommendation algorithm, we dynamically adjust the recommendation results according to the course characteristics and students' learning preferences. Finally, the reinforcement learning algorithm plays a role in optimizing the long-term learning path in the model, and constantly improves the recommendation strategy through real-time feedback. In the experiment, we used multiple real learning platform data sets for validation. The results show that the model has excellent performance in improving students' learning effect and satisfaction, and can effectively recommend learning paths that meet individual needs. Our research provides new ideas and methods for personalized learning of new business education, and promotes the deep integration of education and artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Systematic Study on System Design, Sensing, and Control of Orthopedic Surgical Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Orthopedic surgical robots have revolutionized the landscape of modern surgery, offering unprecedented precision and efficiency. Technological advancements make these robots increasingly important in performing complex surgical procedures. This review focuses on the critical technological facets of orthopedic surgical robots: system design, sensing technologies, and control techniques. We examine how innovative system designs have led to the creation of more adaptive and reliable robotic frameworks. Cutting-edge sensing technologies provide enhanced accuracy and situational awareness, which are crucial for performing delicate operations with minimal invasiveness. Advanced control methods are explored for their role in ensuring seamless interaction and precise movement during surgery. Despite notable advancements, issues such as enhancing the natural interaction between robotic systems and surgeons, as well as improving the precision and accuracy of sensors, remain prevalent. The review highlights current trends and future directions in orthopedic surgical robotics. It enhances understanding of existing capabilities and aim to improve surgical outcomes in orthopedic care.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Risk Prediction Model and Control Using Cloud Computing and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes an enterprise risk prediction model combining cloud computing, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and LightGBM, aiming to improve the real-time performance and accuracy of enterprise risk prediction. Firstly, the large-scale data processing ability of cloud computing platform was used to collect, clean and preprocess multi-source data from finance, market, industry and other sources. Then, LSTM networks are employed to capture the time series characteristics of enterprise risks, effectively extracting both long-term trends and short-term fluctuations in risk indicators through its memory units. After extracting these time-dependent features with LSTM, LightGBM (Light Gradient Boosting Machine) is utilized to model the non-time series data. LightGBM's efficient decision tree algorithm excels at handling large-scale datasets quickly, thereby enhancing the model's predictive performance. Finally, the model is deployed on a cloud computing platform, enabling real-time risk prediction and control. This approach not only improves the accuracy of enterprise risk prediction but also offers excellent scalability and flexibility, making it a robust solution for enterprise risk management.

articleTitle: A Method to Classify Emotions Based on BERT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Nowadays, as science and technology continue to advance, addressing people's emotional issues is of particular significance, and how to accurately and efficiently recognize emotions has become increasingly prominent. We explores sentiment recognition and classification methods, including rule-based approaches, traditional machine learning models, deep learning models, and multi-modal sentiment analysis. Through comparative analysis, we will evaluate the effectiveness of these methods in handling social media texts. Additionally, we has developed a BERT-based two-stage model that first determines sentiment polarity (positive or negative) and then performs detailed classification of negative emotions. This two-stage model significantly improves accuracy and detail recognition compared to traditional one-stage models and other baseline methods. The results show that our approach not only enhances sentiment analysis accuracy but also provides deeper insights into the emotional subtleties of social media texts. This advancement holds significant practical implications for real-time sentiment monitoring and more effective crisis management strategies.

articleTitle: Cos-Triplet Ensemble Learning Model for Quality Scoring and Classification on Rehabilitation Pose Matching System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In a pose matching and guidance system pertinent to rehabilitation training, the establishment of a distinct decision boundary demarcating qualified and unqualified poses is of utmost importance, particularly in domains necessitating precise pose alignment, such as rehabilitation and martial arts training. Moreover, it is imperative for patients to receive real-time feedback regarding their postural alignments during the training sessions. Accomplishing these objectives with high precision and performance presents a formidable challenge. This paper introduces a Cos-Triplet Ensemble Network Combined with Classification Module (CTENM) model, meticulously designed to furnish an accurate pose-matching score concomitant with exceptional precision and accuracy in pose classification. The CTENM model is an intricate stacking model comprising three sub-models, each of which is a costriplet network fortified with varying CNN backbones. In our experiment, VGG16, MobileNet, and ResNet18 were judiciously selected as the backbones for these sub-models. The cos-triplet model represents an innovative modification of the original triplet network. This adaptation incorporates cosine similarity triplet loss as a substitute for the conventional triplet contrastive loss, further augmented with a stochastic weighting mechanism to facilitate classification in triplet settings. Post-training of all sub-models, the stacking ensemble model endeavors to enhance its capabilities by aggregating weighted outputs from the three sub-models. These weight parameters are subsequently refined through training a more comprehensive cos-triplet network. The empirical results gleaned from our experiments affirm the efficacy of the CTENM model in accomplishing the dual tasks of pose matching and guidance with unparalleled accuracy and precision.

articleTitle: Multimodal Fusion Intelligent Driving Fatigue Monitoring and Warning in Police Traffic Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The study presents a multimodal fusion intelligent driving fatigue monitoring and warning system tailored for police traffic scenarios. This system integrates diverse data modalities, including facial expressions, body posture, heart rate, and speech, to achieve comprehensive and precise fatigue detection. Leveraging edge-cloud collaborative computing and infrared image recognition technology, the system operates efficiently across various environmental conditions, enhancing its reliability and stability. The system's adaptability is further demonstrated through its compatibility with different levels of autonomous driving (L1 to L5), offering customized solutions that range from assisted to fully autonomous driving. Specially designed for police operations, the system provides features such as fleet management, equipment integration, and real-time connectivity to command centers, which collectively improve the safety and effectiveness of law enforcement tasks. Compared to traditional single-modality systems, this multimodal approach significantly enhances detection accuracy, stability, and functional diversity, positioning it as a competitive solution for widespread application in both general and specialized driving contexts.

articleTitle: Dangerous Behavior Detection Based on Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Behavior detection is an important research direction in the field of deep learning. CNN has achieved great success in the field of image classification, which promotes the research and development in the field of behavior detection. This paper studies dangerous behavior detection based on CNN algorithm. First of all, the problems of traditional risky behavior detection algorithms are studied, as well as the research progress and development trend of risky behavior detection based on CNN. Then, we study the basis of CNN algorithm, construct CNN network model, and study the working process of convolutional layer, pooling layer and fully connected layer. Then, we study CNN algorithm optimization, including Softmax regression optimization and back propagation algorithm optimization. Finally, KTH data set was selected for simulation experiment, and parameters such as learning rate, convolution kernel and Batch Size were scheduled. On this basis, comprehensive test of risky behavior was carried out. The results show that the CNN algorithm optimized in this paper can improve the accuracy of behavior recognition, which is of great significance in laboratory safety and other fields.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis of Gearbox Based on Residual Network and Data Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The gearbox in the mechanical transmission system runs for a long time under complex working conditions, and its internal parts will inevitably fail. In order to ensure the safe and stable operation of the mechanical system, it is necessary to monitor the condition of the key parts of the gearbox and effectively judge the fault state. At present, the fault diagnosis model based on machine learning has developed rapidly, but the model effect often depends on a large number of high-quality training data samples, which is difficult for the fault diagnosis task, and the fault data generated by the actual operating conditions is limited. And there is often a class imbalance phenomenon. Based on this, this paper uses the data enhancement strategy to expand the class unbalanced data set, and combines the residual neural network to achieve fault feature extraction and accurate diagnosis. The experimental results can prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Power Dialogue System Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative deep reinforcement learning framework for building a power dialogue system, which aims to optimize the interactive experience and efficiency of power services. Therefore, this paper designs a hybrid reinforcement learning architecture combining Deep Q-Network (DQN) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to solve the complex and variable dialogue scenarios in the power field. DQN is responsible for the preliminary value evaluation and action selection due to its efficient exploration ability in discrete action space. However, PPO, with its robust policy optimization mechanism, focuses on the fine adjustment of policies to promote the continuous improvement and optimization of dialogue strategies. The method designed in this paper not only improves the response quality and user satisfaction of the dialogue system, but also enhances the robustness and adaptability of the system to the dynamic environment of the power system. It shows a significant performance improvement in the power dialogue task, and can well handle unstructured user requests and perform precise power service operations. And we can maintain high performance and high reliability in complex and changing environments.

articleTitle: Design and key technology of digital twin body for mobile network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: To solve the problems of high risk, high frequency, significant difficulty, and the challenge of ensuring reliability when implementing dynamic network operations directly in actual networks, this paper proposes a network architecture natively supporting digital twins for mobile networks and provides a detailed design of the digital twin body within the network architecture. This design creates a virtual twin of the physical network entity in a digital manner, empowering the network with capabilities for evaluation, analysis, management, prediction, and optimization. The paper also studies the data technology, modeling technology, and simulation technology within the proposed scheme. Finally, based on the proposed architecture and key technologies, a network digital twin platform is designed, and simulation verification is carried out on this platform for the scenario of network slicing business opening. The experimental results indicate that the proposed scheme can accurately and efficiently achieve verification of slicing parameter con-figuration, business volume prediction, and effectively enhance the efficiency of business opening.

articleTitle: Virtual power plant cloud-management-edge fusion architecture for large-scale application of various types of flexible resources in urban power grids
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to solve the virtual power plant management problem under the optimized layout of various types of flexible resources in urban power grids, a corresponding virtual power plant cloud-management-edge fusion architecture is proposed. The operating characteristics of urban power grids are analyzed, and the main flexibility resource models of urban power grids are established, including photovoltaic power generation, wind turbine output, energy storage, and trigeneration models. The large-scale application of various flexible resources is analyzed. A virtual power plant cloud-management-edge fusion architecture is proposed, the system architecture is designed, the fusion function and network structure are proposed, and the response mechanism is analyzed. Finally, an example analysis is conducted on the urban power grid in a certain region to demonstrate the advantages of the architecture proposed in this paper in terms of resource utilization efficiency and system response speed.

articleTitle: Analysis and research of e-commerce user behavior data based on Spark framework
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the progress and development of The Times, data is becoming more and more important to us. The arrival of Big data has innovated technology in computers and other industries, bringing us into the era of big Data. Due to the rapid development of e-commerce, many e-commerce platforms now use big data technology or cloud computing for data management. At present, the most used big data frameworks are Hadoop and Spark. Through analyzing user behavior data obtained from e-commerce platforms, users' preferences can be guessed and recommended to meet users' needs. Therefore, understanding user behavior is a necessary condition for the development of the e-commerce industry. This paper analyzes the data from the perspective of big data. The data is processed, mined and analyzed through the real data provided by the operators of relevant platforms and corresponding results are obtained. By analyzing users' behaviors and integrating and classifying these data by means of mean clustering algorithm, naive Bayes method, decision tree algorithm and other methods, e-commerce platforms can predict users' favorite and preferred products according to these classified data, which can provide users with corresponding products in a more targeted manner and save each other's time. This paper starts with the preprocessing of e-commerce user behavior data, user behavior feature data mining and user behavior analysis, classifies user data, analyzes the data by classification, and obtains the results. Finally, through the construction of virtual machines and Spark framework environment, the user behavior data of the e-commerce platform is analyzed to obtain the corresponding user purchase information data, and the purchase intention of users is analyzed according to these data.

articleTitle: Establishment of distributed temperature measurement and analysis system for tube plate drying machine
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the temperature of the tube wall of the tube plate dryer cannot get real-time data feedback during the drying process, which affects the moisture at the exit of the leaf wire drying and the sensory quality of the cigarette, a distributed temperature measurement system was innovatively designed to monitor the key temperature change points of the tube wall in real time and ensure the stability and consistency of the parameters during the drying process. Based on the structure of SH35F tube plate wire drying machine, a simulation model was established. The axial and radial distribution characteristics of the temperature field of the barrel of the wire drying machine and the key points of temperature field changes were calculated by means of fluid control equation and heat control equation. A temperature detection unit consisting of battery module, temperature measurement module and temperature sensor probe was installed at the key points of temperature change of the barrel. To achieve high precision continuous temperature measurement, and then use lora module to form a wireless network for data transmission, each measurement point is configured with a wireless transmission module, so that the real-time monitoring data of each temperature measurement unit can be uniformly transmitted through wireless communication to the supreme computer for data transmission and processing. MySQL database is used to develop the system database for data processing, storage, display and analysis. Finally, taking A brand of cigarettes as the research object, the temperature acquisition system was used to continuously sample the temperature of the dryer cylinder wall during the production process. The results showed that the temperature detection system reached normal operation, and the temperature detection accuracy was less than 0.2 °C. The transmission of measurement data runs stably, the effective working distance of the wireless signal receiver reaches 20 meters without occlusion, and the operating stability of the data processing and analysis evaluation system reaches 100%. The distributed temperature measurement system established in this study provides important technical support for stabilizing the production parameters in the process of silk drying, and lays an important foundation for continuously improving the quality of silk drying and optimizing the production process of tobacco.

articleTitle: Application of passive wireless communication technology in online monitoring scenario of sulfur hexafluoride micro-water and density in hydropower station
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Water content and gas density of sulfur hexafluoride (SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>) in gas insulated switchgear (GIS) are key parameters affecting the safe operation of a power station. Traditional monitoring methods usually rely on active sensors, which require regular battery replacement and are limited by monitoring distances, making it difficult to meet the needs of long-term, high-reliability monitoring. In this paper, a novel sensor based on passive wireless communication technology was proposed for online monitoring of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> micro water content and density. Powered by microwave energy emitted by a dedicated communication gateway, the sensor does not need to rely on battery power, enabling remote measurements over a distance of more than 20 meters. The passive wireless sensor solution proposed in this paper not only reduced the cost of equipment operation and maintenance, but also improved the real-time performance and reliability of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas monitoring in hydropower station, and has a wide application prospect. The application of this technology will provide a more effective guarantee for the operation safety of hydropower stations, and promote the further development of passive wireless communication technology in the field of industrial monitoring.

articleTitle: Multi Modal Sentiment Analysis Model Integrating Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Single-modal sentiment analysis technology cannot deal with multi-modal sentiment analysis directly and effectively, and sentiment analysis for multi-modal data has attracted more and more attention. In this paper, attention mechanism is used to interact all modal information in a more comprehensive way. Following the multi-modal emotion analysis paradigm based on attention mechanism, a multi-modal emotion analysis model integrating attention mechanism is designed. The sentiment analysis model designed in this paper has a hierarchical structure, in which the data input layer includes input text, audio and video. Feature extraction layer includes text feature extraction, audio feature extraction and image feature extraction. The attention features fusion layer maps the extracted three modal features to a common attention space, which is learned through a fully connected neural network and activation function. The gated memory layer uses GRUs to model multimodal timing features as storage units and summarize context information. Sentiment analysis layer realizes information sharing through multi-task learning and sharing presentation layer parameters, thus improving the performance of multiple tasks at the same time.

articleTitle: Application of a multi-objective optimization model based on IDSS in forest resource management
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The increasing global demand for sustainable forest resource management highlights the significance of intelligent decision support systems (IDSS) in this field. This study proposes a multi-objective optimization model based on IDSS to enhance the efficiency and sustainability of forest management. By integrating ecological, economic, and social goals, the model addresses the conflicts between forest development and conservation, providing a scientific basis for policymakers. The research first identifies key challenges in managing forest resources, such as biodiversity conservation, economic maximization, and community involvement. A multi-objective optimization framework is then developed using techniques like decision trees and genetic algorithms. Case studies validate the model's effectiveness, showing that the IDSS-based approach offers real-time, accurate information to decision-makers and facilitates sustainable resource use through trade-offs among objectives. The findings offer a crucial theoretical foundation and practical guidance for future forest management policies.

articleTitle: Optimization of Spatial and Temporal Distribution of Carbon Emissions in a Thermoelectric Coupled System Based on the Cooperative Control Strategy of Electric and Thermal Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Aiming at the carbon emission optimization of the thermoelectric coupling system, this paper innovatively designs the electrothermal energy storage collaborative PRO-CIES system, which improves the flexibility of the system through energy storage technology and optimizes the wind energy absorption by using time translation characteristics. We need to combine carbon trading and system constraints to optimize low-carbon economic scheduling. The empirical results show that, compared with the carbon trading model only, the proposed scheme can reduce wind abandonment by 8.12% and carbon emission by 88.27 tons. Compared with the electric energy storage model, the wind curtailation is reduced by 7.04%, and the carbon emission is reduced by 159.3 tons. Although the cost is slightly increased, the wind energy utilization and emission reduction are remarkable, which strongly supports the sustainable development of the energy system.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Optimization in Hybrid Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the growing integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in hybrid vehicles, significant advancements have been made in improving their environmental perception, energy management, path planning, and charge optimization. This paper focuses on the application of AI optimization in hybrid vehicles, presenting an overview of key AI technologies and algorithms such as SSD, SLAM, PSO, and FLC. The study shows how these technologies enhance vehicle performance by improving detection accuracy, energy efficiency, and driving strategies. Additionally, the research highlights the challenges AI faces in real-time performance and dynamic adaptability, providing insights for future development. This work contributes to ongoing research aimed at achieving safer, more efficient, and intelligent autonomous driving systems.

articleTitle: Study on Monostatic RCS Fluctuation Model of a Small Artificial Satellite
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper investigates the statistical properties of the artificial "Jilin-1" platform 01A01 satellite’s radar scattering cross section (RCS) in 2GHz, 4GHz, and 6GHz. The RCS calculations are performed using the physical optics (PO) method and the multilayer fast multipole method (MLFMM), and the RCS data are fitted and analyzed using six statistical models, including normal, lognormal, chi-square, Weibull, polynomial, and Legendre distributions. The distribution characteristics of the RCS at different frequencies were investigated by kernel density estimation (KDE) and different statistical evaluation metrics, including R-square, Modified R-square, Sum Square Error (SSE), and Root mean squared error (RMSE). The results show that the normal distribution fits best at 2 GHz, 4 GHz, and 6 GHz. Lognormal distribution fits, and normal distribution fits. This study provides a new perspective for the distribution fitting of RCS for future vehicles, which helps to improve the accuracy of radar system performance evaluation and target detection.

articleTitle: Research on Sentiment Analysis of User Reviews Based on BERT and Parallel Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In recent years, with the increasing prominence of environmental and energy issues, people’s demand for environmentally friendly transportation is gradually increasing, providing a broader market space for new energy vehicles. In this paper, we chose Auto Home as the research object to explore the users' emotional orientation towards new energy vehicles. In order to solve the problem of poor extraction of text features by traditional methods, a hybrid BERT-CNN+BiLSTM parallel network model incorporating an attention mechanism is designed. User review data was collected and pre-processed, we labeled the reviews with emotion according to the different star ratings. Second, the word cloud was used to analyze the processed data to visualize the high-frequency keywords. Once again, the processed data is imported into the model for text sentiment discrimination. Among them, BERT captures the contextual relationship between words and provides rich semantic information, CNN extracts key local features in text through multiple convolutional kernels, and BiLSTM focuses on capturing full text feature information. Based on this, the attention mechanism is introduced, and the fused output of CNN and BiLSTM is used as the input of the attention mechanism, and the final sentiment classification results are obtained. Compared with the traditional model, it has higher accuracy and precision and performs well on this dataset.

articleTitle: Research and Design of a Multifunctional Heart Rate Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Addressing the limitations of conventional heart rate detectors, which solely monitor heart rate without providing alerts during critical incidents, a multifunctional heart rate detection system has been developed. This system incorporates a GD32 as the main controller and utilizes a pulse sensor for heart rate monitoring, an MLX90614 infrared temperature sensor for body temperature measurements, an MPU6050 acceleration sensor for motion posture detection, and a SIM868 module for GPS positioning and server communication. This comprehensive setup allows for real-time monitoring of the wearer’s heart rate and body temperature, assessment of fall incidents based on motion posture data, and regular uploading of health data to a server. Additionally, the system is equipped with a one-touch emergency call feature. In the event of abnormal heart rate readings or a fall, it triggers an alarm, acquires GPS coordinates, and automatically dials an emergency contact number. After thorough testing and verification, the system has demonstrated full functionality with heart rate data accuracy within the expected error range, offering a reliable safety mechanism for patients while on the move.

articleTitle: A study of photovoltaic power plant siting based on multi criteria decision analysis and spatio temporal prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study is dedicated to optimizing the site selection of photovoltaic power stations, aiming to address China's dual challenges in ensuring power supply and environmental protection by integrating multi criteria decision analysis and spatiotemporal prediction technology. The Spearman correlation analysis and heatmap revealed the high correlation between key factors affecting the site selection of photovoltaic power plants, and the Elastic Net algorithm was introduced to optimize the selection of independent variables, improving the stability and prediction accuracy of the model. The ARIMA (2,1,1) model was used to predict the future trend of electricity supply in China, and the results showed that the electricity supply in China will reach 2179 GW · h by 2060. A comprehensive evaluation model for photovoltaic power station site selection was constructed based on multi criteria decision analysis, ensuring reasonable planning of power station locations, fully utilizing local natural conditions, and reducing pressure on the power grid. The experiment verified the effectiveness and reliability of the model, providing theoretical basis and technical support for promoting the development of China's photovoltaic industry.
